FROM node:22-alpine AS builder
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm install --legacy-peer-deps
COPY tsconfig.json ./
COPY src ./src
RUN npm run build

FROM node:22-alpine
WORKDIR /app
ENV NODE_ENV=production
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm install --omit=dev --legacy-peer-deps && npm cache clean --force
COPY --from=builder /app/dist ./dist
USER node
EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["node", "dist/server.js"]

#!/bin/bash
cd ~/ai-backend

echo "=== 1. Auto-Patching Files ==="
cat > patch_script.js << 'JS'
const fs = require('fs');

// 1. Patch project-guard.ts
let pgPath = 'src/modules/anime/auth/project-guard.ts';
let pgContent = fs.readFileSync(pgPath, 'utf8');
if (!pgContent.includes('(request.user as any)?.sub')) {
    pgContent = pgContent.replace(
        "const authenticatedUserId = request.authContext?.userId;",
        "const authenticatedUserId = request.authContext?.userId || (request.user as any)?.sub || (request.user as any)?.id;"
    );
    fs.writeFileSync(pgPath, pgContent);
    console.log('✅ project-guard.ts fixed');
}

// 2. Patch commands.routes.ts
let crPath = 'src/modules/anime/commands/commands.routes.ts';
let crContent = fs.readFileSync(crPath, 'utf8');
if (!crContent.includes('(request.user as any)?.sub')) {
    // POST route fix
    crContent = crContent.replace(
        "const userId = request.anime?.user_id ?? request.authContext?.userId;",
        "const userId = request.anime?.user_id ?? request.authContext?.userId ?? (request.user as any)?.sub ?? (request.user as any)?.id;"
    );
    // GET route fix
    crContent = crContent.replace(
        "const userId = request.authContext?.userId;",
        "const userId = request.authContext?.userId || (request.user as any)?.sub || (request.user as any)?.id;"
    );
    fs.writeFileSync(crPath, crContent);
    console.log('✅ commands.routes.ts fixed');
}
JS
node patch_script.js
rm patch_script.js

echo ""
echo "=== 2. Docker Rebuild (Wait 15 sec) ==="
sudo docker build -t ec2-user-backend .

echo ""
echo "=== 3. Docker Restart ==="
sudo docker stop ai-backend && sudo docker rm ai-backend
sudo docker run -d --name ai-backend --restart unless-stopped --env-file .env -p 127.0.0.1:3000:3000 ec2-user-backend

echo ""
echo "=== 4. Waiting for server to start... ==="
sleep 5

echo ""
echo "=== 5. Running SSO Test ==="
bash test_sso.sh

FILE: auto_test.sh

#!/bin/bash
echo "Logging in automatically..."
LOGIN_RES=$(curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/auth/login -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"email":"admin@example.com", "password":"Admin@12345"}')
TOKEN=$(echo $LOGIN_RES | grep -o '"token":"[^"]*' | cut -d'"' -f4)
if [ -z "$TOKEN" ]; then echo "Login failed! Check password."; exit 1; fi
echo "Token fetched successfully. Running tests..."
API_URL="http://localhost:3000/api/ai"
HEADERS=(-H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json")
echo -e "
[TEST 1 & 2: Chat + Prompt + Router]"
curl -s -X POST "$API_URL/chat" "${HEADERS[@]}" -d '{"message": "Who are you?"}' | grep -q "reply" && echo "✅ Chat working (Router/Prompt OK)" || echo "❌ Failed"
echo -e "
[TEST 3: Quota RPM]"
for i in {1..5}; do
  RESP=$(curl -s -X POST "$API_URL/chat" "${HEADERS[@]}" -d '{"message": "spam"}')
  if echo "$RESP" | grep -q "Rate limit"; then echo "✅ Quota triggered at request $i"; break; fi
done
echo "Tests Complete!"

  readonly project_id: string | null;
  readonly workflow_name: string;

  readonly new_value?: unknown;

  readonly execution_id?: string | null;

export async function writeAudit(entry: AuditEntryInput): Promise<void> {

      episode_no: entry.episode_no ?? null,

    });

}

cat > src/modules/anime/adapters/n8n.adapter.ts << 'EOF'
import { createHmac } from 'node:crypto';
import { animeEnv } from '../config/anime.env';
import { AnimeError, AnimeErrorCode } from '../errors/anime.errors';
export function computeN8nHmacSignature(timestampSec: string, rawBody: string, secret: string): string {
  return `sha256=${createHmac('sha256', secret).update(`${timestampSec}.${rawBody}`, 'utf8').digest('hex')}`;
}
export async function dispatchToWf00(envelope: any, timeoutMs = 15000): Promise<any> {
  const targetUrl = process.env.WF_00_WEBHOOK_URL?.trim() || `${(process.env.N8N_BASE_URL || '').replace(/\/+$/, '')}/webhook/anime-master-router`;
  if (!targetUrl || targetUrl === '/webhook/anime-master-router') throw new AnimeError({ code: AnimeErrorCode.INTERNAL, message: 'WF_00_WEBHOOK_URL missing.', retryable: false });
  const timestampSec = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000).toString(); const rawBody = JSON.stringify(envelope);
  const signature = computeN8nHmacSignature(timestampSec, rawBody, animeEnv.ANIME_N8N_CALLBACK_SECRET);
  const controller = new AbortController(); const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), timeoutMs);
  try {
    const response = await fetch(targetUrl, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-Anime-Timestamp': timestampSec, 'X-Anime-Signature': signature, 'X-Request-Id': envelope.request_id, 'Idempotency-Key': envelope.idempotency_key }, body: rawBody, signal: controller.signal });
    if (!response.ok) throw new AnimeError({ code: response.status >= 500 ? AnimeErrorCode.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE : AnimeErrorCode.WORKFLOW_CONTRACT_MISMATCH, message: `HTTP ${response.status}`, retryable: response.status >= 500 });
    const parsed = await response.json() as any;
    return { ok: true, status: parsed?.status || 'ACKNOWLEDGED', execution_id: parsed?.execution_id || null, raw: parsed || {} };
  } catch (err: any) {
    if (err instanceof AnimeError) throw err;
    throw new AnimeError({ code: AnimeErrorCode.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE, message: err.message, retryable: true });
  } finally { clearTimeout(timer); }
}
EOF

cat > src/modules/anime/commands/commands.repo.ts << 'EOF'
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { animeSupabase } from '../db/anime.supabase';
import { AnimeError, AnimeErrorCode } from '../errors/anime.errors';
import { type ApiCommandRecord, type CommandIntent, CommandStatus } from './commands.types';
export async function findCommandByIdempotencyKey(idempotencyKey: string): Promise<ApiCommandRecord | null> {
  const { data, error } = await animeSupabase.from('api_commands').select('*').eq('idempotency_key', idempotencyKey).maybeSingle<ApiCommandRecord>();
  if (error) throw new AnimeError({ code: AnimeErrorCode.INTERNAL, message: 'Query failed', cause: error });
  return data;
}
export async function findCommandById(commandId: string): Promise<ApiCommandRecord | null> {
  const { data, error } = await animeSupabase.from('api_commands').select('*').eq('id', commandId).maybeSingle<ApiCommandRecord>();
  if (error) throw new AnimeError({ code: AnimeErrorCode.INTERNAL, message: 'Query failed', cause: error });
  return data;
}
export async function insertCommandAtomic(input: any): Promise<ApiCommandRecord> {
  const commandId = input.command_id ?? randomUUID(); const outboxId = randomUUID(); const status = input.status ?? CommandStatus.QUEUED;
  const rpcResult = await animeSupabase.rpc('insert_anime_command_atomic', { p_command_id: commandId, p_project_id: input.project_id, p_user_id: input.user_id, p_intent: input.intent, p_payload: input.payload, p_status: status, p_idempotency_key: input.idempotency_key, p_body_hash: input.body_hash, p_outbox_id: outboxId, p_outbox_type: input.outbox_type, p_outbox_payload: input.outbox_payload }).maybeSingle<ApiCommandRecord>();
  if (!rpcResult.error && rpcResult.data) return rpcResult.data;
  if (rpcResult.error && rpcResult.error.code === '23505') { const existing = await findCommandByIdempotencyKey(input.idempotency_key); if (existing) return existing; }
  const { data: insertedCommand, error: cmdError } = await animeSupabase.from('api_commands').insert({ id: commandId, project_id: input.project_id, user_id: input.user_id, intent: input.intent, payload: input.payload, status, idempotency_key: input.idempotency_key, body_hash: input.body_hash }).select().single<ApiCommandRecord>();
  if (cmdError) { if (cmdError.code === '23505') { const existing = await findCommandByIdempotencyKey(input.idempotency_key); if (existing) return existing; } throw new AnimeError({ code: AnimeErrorCode.INTERNAL, message: 'Insert failed', cause: cmdError }); }
  await animeSupabase.from('outbox_events').insert({ id: outboxId, type: input.outbox_type, payload: input.outbox_payload, status: 'pending', attempts: 0 });
  return insertedCommand;
}
EOF

import { z } from 'zod';
export const AnimeProcessRoleEnum = z.enum(['api', 'dispatcher', 'supervisor', 'worker']);
export type AnimeProcessRole = z.infer<typeof AnimeProcessRoleEnum>;
export const animeEnvSchema = z.object({
  ANIME_SUPABASE_URL: z.string().url(), ANIME_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY: z.string().min(1), ANIME_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY: z.string().min(1),
  ANIME_N8N_CALLBACK_SECRET: z.string().min(1), ANIME_WORKER_CALLBACK_SECRET: z.string().min(1), ANIME_PROCESS_ROLE: AnimeProcessRoleEnum,
});
export type AnimeEnv = z.infer<typeof animeEnvSchema>;
function parseAnimeEnvOnce(rawEnv: NodeJS.ProcessEnv): Readonly<AnimeEnv> {
  const parsed = animeEnvSchema.safeParse(rawEnv);
  if (parsed.success === false) throw new Error('[AnimeEngine] Invalid env: ' + parsed.error.issues.map(i => i.path.join('.')).join(', '));
  return Object.freeze(parsed.data);
}
export const animeEnv: Readonly<AnimeEnv> = parseAnimeEnvOnce(process.env);
EOF

cat > src/modules/anime/errors/anime.errors.ts << 'EOF'
import type { FastifyError, FastifyReply, FastifyRequest } from 'fastify';
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
export enum AnimeErrorCode { AUTH_INVALID = 'AUTH_INVALID', PROJECT_FORBIDDEN = 'PROJECT_FORBIDDEN', VERSION_CONFLICT = 'VERSION_CONFLICT', IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT = 'IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT', MISSING_IDEMPOTENCY = 'MISSING_IDEMPOTENCY', APPROVAL_REQUIRED = 'APPROVAL_REQUIRED', PAID_BUDGET_REQUIRED = 'PAID_BUDGET_REQUIRED', QUOTA_DEFERRED = 'QUOTA_DEFERRED', PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE = 'PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE', STAGE_DEPENDENCY_BLOCKED = 'STAGE_DEPENDENCY_BLOCKED', OUTPUT_INVALID = 'OUTPUT_INVALID', QC_FAILED = 'QC_FAILED', WORKFLOW_CONTRACT_MISMATCH = 'WORKFLOW_CONTRACT_MISMATCH', CALLBACK_REPLAY = 'CALLBACK_REPLAY', CALLBACK_SIGNATURE_INVALID = 'CALLBACK_SIGNATURE_INVALID', MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED = 'MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED', INTERNAL = 'INTERNAL' }
export const ANIME_ERROR_SPEC_MAP: any = { [AnimeErrorCode.AUTH_INVALID]: { httpStatus: 401, defaultRetryable: false }, [AnimeErrorCode.PROJECT_FORBIDDEN]: { httpStatus: 403, defaultRetryable: false }, [AnimeErrorCode.VERSION_CONFLICT]: { httpStatus: 409, defaultRetryable: false }, [AnimeErrorCode.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT]: { httpStatus: 409, defaultRetryable: false }, [AnimeErrorCode.MISSING_IDEMPOTENCY]: { httpStatus: 400, defaultRetryable: false }, [AnimeErrorCode.APPROVAL_REQUIRED]: { httpStatus: 403, defaultRetryable: false }, [AnimeErrorCode.PAID_BUDGET_REQUIRED]: { httpStatus: 402, defaultRetryable: false }, [AnimeErrorCode.QUOTA_DEFERRED]: { httpStatus: 429, defaultRetryable: true }, [AnimeErrorCode.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE]: { httpStatus: 503, defaultRetryable: true }, [AnimeErrorCode.STAGE_DEPENDENCY_BLOCKED]: { httpStatus: 409, defaultRetryable: true }, [AnimeErrorCode.OUTPUT_INVALID]: { httpStatus: 422, defaultRetryable: false }, [AnimeErrorCode.QC_FAILED]: { httpStatus: 422, defaultRetryable: false }, [AnimeErrorCode.WORKFLOW_CONTRACT_MISMATCH]: { httpStatus: 502, defaultRetryable: false }, [AnimeErrorCode.CALLBACK_REPLAY]: { httpStatus: 409, defaultRetryable: false }, [AnimeErrorCode.CALLBACK_SIGNATURE_INVALID]: { httpStatus: 401, defaultRetryable: false }, [AnimeErrorCode.MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED]: { httpStatus: 423, defaultRetryable: false }, [AnimeErrorCode.INTERNAL]: { httpStatus: 500, defaultRetryable: true } };
export class AnimeError extends Error {
  public readonly code: AnimeErrorCode; public readonly httpStatus: number; public readonly retryable: boolean;
  constructor(options: { code: AnimeErrorCode, message: string, httpStatus?: number, retryable?: boolean, cause?: unknown }) {
    super(options.message, options.cause !== undefined ? { cause: options.cause } : undefined);
    this.name = 'AnimeError'; const spec = ANIME_ERROR_SPEC_MAP[options.code] ?? ANIME_ERROR_SPEC_MAP[AnimeErrorCode.INTERNAL];
    this.code = options.code; this.httpStatus = options.httpStatus ?? spec.httpStatus; this.retryable = options.retryable ?? spec.defaultRetryable;
  }
}
export function animeErrorHandler(error: FastifyError | AnimeError | Error, request: FastifyRequest, reply: FastifyReply): void {
  const requestId = (request as any).anime?.request_id ?? randomUUID();
  if (!reply.hasHeader('X-Request-Id')) reply.header('X-Request-Id', requestId);
  if (error instanceof AnimeError) return void reply.status(error.httpStatus).send({ error: { code: error.code, message: error.message, retryable: error.retryable, request_id: requestId } });
  request.log.error({ err: error, request_id: requestId }, '[AnimeEngine] Unhandled error');
  void reply.status(500).send({ error: { code: AnimeErrorCode.INTERNAL, message: 'Internal error.', retryable: true, request_id: requestId } });
}
EOF

cat > src/modules/anime/auth/project-guard.ts << 'EOF'
import type { FastifyReply, FastifyRequest } from 'fastify';
import { animeSupabase } from '../db/anime.supabase';
import { AnimeError, AnimeErrorCode } from '../errors/anime.errors';
export function requireProjectRole(allowedRoles: string[]) {
  return async function projectRolePreHandler(request: FastifyRequest, reply: FastifyReply): Promise<void> {
    const authCtx = (request as any).authContext;
    const authenticatedUserId = authCtx?.userId;
    if (!authenticatedUserId) throw new AnimeError({ code: AnimeErrorCode.AUTH_INVALID, message: 'Missing auth context.' });
    const projectId = (request.params as any)?.id || (request.params as any)?.project_id || (request.body as any)?.project_id;
    if (!projectId) throw new AnimeError({ code: AnimeErrorCode.PROJECT_FORBIDDEN, message: 'Missing project_id.' });
    const { data, error } = await animeSupabase.from('projects').select('id, user_id').eq('id', projectId).single();
    if (error || !data || data.user_id !== authenticatedUserId) throw new AnimeError({ code: AnimeErrorCode.PROJECT_FORBIDDEN, message: 'Access denied.' });
    if (!allowedRoles.includes('owner')) throw new AnimeError({ code: AnimeErrorCode.PROJECT_FORBIDDEN, message: 'Insufficient role.' });
    (request as any).anime = { ...(request as any).anime, user_id: authenticatedUserId, project_id: projectId, role: 'owner' };
  };
}
EOF

cat > src/modules/anime/commands/commands.repo.ts << 'EOF'
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { animeSupabase } from '../db/anime.supabase';
import { AnimeError, AnimeErrorCode } from '../errors/anime.errors';
import { type ApiCommandRecord, type CommandIntent, CommandStatus } from './commands.types';
export async function findCommandByIdempotencyKey(idempotencyKey: string): Promise<ApiCommandRecord | null> {
  const { data, error } = await animeSupabase.from('api_commands').select('*').eq('idempotency_key', idempotencyKey).maybeSingle();
  if (error) throw new AnimeError({ code: AnimeErrorCode.INTERNAL, message: 'Query failed', cause: error });
  return data;
}
export async function findCommandById(commandId: string): Promise<ApiCommandRecord | null> {
  const { data, error } = await animeSupabase.from('api_commands').select('*').eq('id', commandId).maybeSingle();
  if (error) throw new AnimeError({ code: AnimeErrorCode.INTERNAL, message: 'Query failed', cause: error });
  return data;
}
export async function insertCommandAtomic(input: any): Promise<ApiCommandRecord> {
  const commandId = input.command_id ?? randomUUID(); const outboxId = randomUUID(); const status = input.status ?? CommandStatus.QUEUED;
  const rpcResult = await animeSupabase.rpc('insert_anime_command_atomic', { p_command_id: commandId, p_project_id: input.project_id, p_user_id: input.user_id, p_intent: input.intent, p_payload: input.payload, p_status: status, p_idempotency_key: input.idempotency_key, p_body_hash: input.body_hash, p_outbox_id: outboxId, p_outbox_type: input.outbox_type, p_outbox_payload: input.outbox_payload }).maybeSingle();
  if (!rpcResult.error && rpcResult.data) return rpcResult.data;
  if (rpcResult.error && rpcResult.error.code === '23505') { const existing = await findCommandByIdempotencyKey(input.idempotency_key); if (existing) return existing; }
  const { data: insertedCommand, error: cmdError } = await animeSupabase.from('api_commands').insert({ id: commandId, project_id: input.project_id, user_id: input.user_id, intent: input.intent, payload: input.payload, status, idempotency_key: input.idempotency_key, body_hash: input.body_hash }).select().single();
  if (cmdError) { if (cmdError.code === '23505') { const existing = await findCommandByIdempotencyKey(input.idempotency_key); if (existing) return existing; } throw new AnimeError({ code: AnimeErrorCode.INTERNAL, message: 'Insert failed', cause: cmdError }); }
  await animeSupabase.from('outbox_events').insert({ id: outboxId, type: input.outbox_type, payload: input.outbox_payload, status: 'pending', attempts: 0 });
  return insertedCommand;
}

import { createHash, randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { writeAudit } from '../audit/audit.writer';
import { AnimeError, AnimeErrorCode } from '../errors/anime.errors';
import { retrieveContext } from '../intelligence/memory.service';
import { preflightCheck } from '../intelligence/planner.service';
import { findCommandById, findCommandByIdempotencyKey, insertCommandAtomic } from './commands.repo';
import type { CreateCommandBody } from './commands.schema';
import { type ApiCommandRecord, COMMAND_INTENT_WF_MAP, CommandStatus, type WorkflowKey } from './commands.types';
export async function submitAnimeCommand(params: { idempotencyKey: string | undefined; userId: string; requestId: string; body: CreateCommandBody; }): Promise<any> {
  const rawKey = params.idempotencyKey?.trim();
  if (!rawKey) throw new AnimeError({ code: AnimeErrorCode.MISSING_IDEMPOTENCY, message: 'Header Idempotency-Key is required.' });
  const wfKey = COMMAND_INTENT_WF_MAP[params.body.intent];
  if (!wfKey) throw new AnimeError({ code: AnimeErrorCode.WORKFLOW_CONTRACT_MISMATCH, message: `Unsupported intent: ${String(params.body.intent)}` });
  const bodyHash = createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(params.body)).digest('hex');
  const existing = await findCommandByIdempotencyKey(rawKey);
  if (existing) {
    if (existing.body_hash !== bodyHash || existing.project_id !== params.body.project_id) throw new AnimeError({ code: AnimeErrorCode.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT, message: 'Conflict.' });
    return { command: existing, wf_key: COMMAND_INTENT_WF_MAP[existing.intent], idempotent_replay: true };
  }
  await preflightCheck(params.body.project_id, params.body.intent);
  const memories = await retrieveContext(params.body.project_id, params.body.intent);
  const commandId = randomUUID();
  const enrichedPayload = { ...(params.body.payload ?? {}), mode: params.body.mode ?? 'SAVE', ...(params.body.episode_no !== undefined ? { episode_no: params.body.episode_no } : {}), wf_key: wfKey, request_id: params.requestId, memories };
  const outboxPayload = { command_id: commandId, project_id: params.body.project_id, user_id: params.userId, intent: params.body.intent, wf_key: wfKey, mode: params.body.mode ?? 'SAVE', episode_no: params.body.episode_no ?? null, idempotency_key: rawKey, request_id: params.requestId, payload: enrichedPayload };
  const created = await insertCommandAtomic({ command_id: commandId, project_id: params.body.project_id, user_id: params.userId, intent: params.body.intent, payload: enrichedPayload, status: CommandStatus.QUEUED, idempotency_key: rawKey, body_hash: bodyHash, outbox_type: `ANIME_COMMAND_DISPATCH:${wfKey}`, outbox_payload: outboxPayload });
  if (created.id !== commandId) {
    if (created.body_hash !== bodyHash || created.project_id !== params.body.project_id) throw new AnimeError({ code: AnimeErrorCode.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT, message: 'Concurrent conflict.' });
    return { command: created, wf_key: COMMAND_INTENT_WF_MAP[created.intent], idempotent_replay: true };
  }
  await writeAudit({ project_id: params.body.project_id, user_id: params.userId, episode_no: params.body.episode_no ?? null, workflow_name: wfKey, action: params.body.intent, entity_type: 'API_COMMAND', entity_id: created.id, new_value: { command_id: created.id, status: created.status }, request_id: params.requestId });
  return { command: created, wf_key: wfKey, idempotent_replay: false };
}
export async function getAnimeCommandForUser(commandId: string, userId: string): Promise<ApiCommandRecord> {
  const command = await findCommandById(commandId);
  if (!command || command.user_id !== userId) throw new AnimeError({ code: AnimeErrorCode.PROJECT_FORBIDDEN, message: 'Access denied.' });
  return command;
}

import { createHmac } from 'node:crypto';
import { animeEnv } from '../config/anime.env';
import { AnimeError, AnimeErrorCode } from '../errors/anime.errors';
export function computeN8nHmacSignature(timestampSec: string, rawBody: string, secret: string): string {
  return `sha256=${createHmac('sha256', secret).update(`${timestampSec}.${rawBody}`, 'utf8').digest('hex')}`;
}
export async function dispatchToWf00(envelope: any, timeoutMs = 15000): Promise<any> {
  const targetUrl = process.env.WF_00_WEBHOOK_URL?.trim() || `${(process.env.N8N_BASE_URL || '').replace(/\/+$/, '')}/webhook/anime-master-router`;
  if (!targetUrl || targetUrl === '/webhook/anime-master-router') throw new AnimeError({ code: AnimeErrorCode.INTERNAL, message: 'WF_00_WEBHOOK_URL missing.', retryable: false });
  const timestampSec = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000).toString(); const rawBody = JSON.stringify(envelope);
  const signature = computeN8nHmacSignature(timestampSec, rawBody, animeEnv.ANIME_N8N_CALLBACK_SECRET);
  const controller = new AbortController(); const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), timeoutMs);
  try {
    const response = await fetch(targetUrl, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-Anime-Timestamp': timestampSec, 'X-Anime-Signature': signature, 'X-Request-Id': envelope.request_id, 'Idempotency-Key': envelope.idempotency_key }, body: rawBody, signal: controller.signal });
    if (!response.ok) throw new AnimeError({ code: response.status >= 500 ? AnimeErrorCode.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE : AnimeErrorCode.WORKFLOW_CONTRACT_MISMATCH, message: `HTTP ${response.status}`, retryable: response.status >= 500 });
    const parsed = await response.json();
    return { ok: true, status: parsed.status || 'ACKNOWLEDGED', execution_id: parsed.execution_id || null, raw: parsed };
  } catch (err: any) {
    if (err instanceof AnimeError) throw err;
    throw new AnimeError({ code: AnimeErrorCode.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE, message: err.message, retryable: true });
  } finally { clearTimeout(timer); }
}

cat > src/modules/anime/callbacks/signature.ts << 'EOF'
import { createHmac, timingSafeEqual } from 'node:crypto';
import { AnimeError, AnimeErrorCode } from '../errors/anime.errors';
const FIVE_MINUTES_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000;
const MAX_NONCE_CACHE_ENTRIES = 5000;
const nonceLruCache = new Map<string, number>();
function evictExpiredOrOverflowNonces(nowMs: number): void {
  for (const [key, expiresAt] of nonceLruCache.entries()) {
    if (expiresAt <= nowMs) nonceLruCache.delete(key);
  }
  while (nonceLruCache.size >= MAX_NONCE_CACHE_ENTRIES) {
    const oldestKey = nonceLruCache.keys().next().value;
    if (oldestKey === undefined) break;
    nonceLruCache.delete(oldestKey);
  }
}
export function signCallbackPayload(timestampSec: string, rawBody: string, secret: string): string {
  const digest = createHmac('sha256', secret).update(`${timestampSec}.${rawBody}`, 'utf8').digest('hex');
  return `sha256=${digest}`;
}
export function verifyCallbackSignature(input: { rawBody: string; signatureHeader: string | undefined; timestampHeader: string | undefined; nonceHeader?: string | undefined; secret: string; }): void {
  const signatureRaw = input.signatureHeader?.trim();
  const timestampRaw = input.timestampHeader?.trim();
  if (!signatureRaw || !timestampRaw) throw new AnimeError({ code: AnimeErrorCode.CALLBACK_SIGNATURE_INVALID, message: 'Missing callback signature or timestamp.' });
  const timestampSec = Number(timestampRaw);
  if (!Number.isFinite(timestampSec) || timestampSec <= 0) throw new AnimeError({ code: AnimeErrorCode.CALLBACK_SIGNATURE_INVALID, message: 'Invalid callback timestamp.' });
  const nowMs = Date.now();
  if (Math.abs(nowMs - timestampSec * 1000) > FIVE_MINUTES_MS) throw new AnimeError({ code: AnimeErrorCode.CALLBACK_SIGNATURE_INVALID, message: 'Callback timestamp outside 5-minute window.' });
  const expectedSig = signCallbackPayload(timestampRaw, input.rawBody, input.secret);
  const normalizedProvided = signatureRaw.startsWith('sha256=') ? signatureRaw : `sha256=${signatureRaw}`;
  const expectedBuf = Buffer.from(expectedSig, 'utf8'); const providedBuf = Buffer.from(normalizedProvided, 'utf8');
  if (expectedBuf.length !== providedBuf.length || timingSafeEqual(expectedBuf, providedBuf) === false) throw new AnimeError({ code: AnimeErrorCode.CALLBACK_SIGNATURE_INVALID, message: 'HMAC signature failed.' });
  evictExpiredOrOverflowNonces(nowMs);
  const nonceKey = input.nonceHeader?.trim() || `${timestampRaw}:${normalizedProvided}`;
  const existingExpiry = nonceLruCache.get(nonceKey);
  if (existingExpiry !== undefined && existingExpiry > nowMs) throw new AnimeError({ code: AnimeErrorCode.CALLBACK_REPLAY, message: 'Callback replay detected.' });
  nonceLruCache.delete(nonceKey); nonceLruCache.set(nonceKey, nowMs + FIVE_MINUTES_MS);
}

import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { writeAudit } from '../audit/audit.writer';
import { animeEnv } from '../config/anime.env';
import { animeSupabase } from '../db/anime.supabase';
import { AnimeError, AnimeErrorCode } from '../errors/anime.errors';
import { insertCallback } from './callbacks.repo';
import { verifyCallbackSignature } from './signature';
export async function handleCallbackRequest(input: { source: 'n8n' | 'worker'; rawBody: string; signatureHeader: string | undefined; timestampHeader: string | undefined; nonceHeader: string | undefined; requestId: string; }): Promise<any> {
  const secret = input.source === 'n8n' ? animeEnv.ANIME_N8N_CALLBACK_SECRET : animeEnv.ANIME_WORKER_CALLBACK_SECRET;
  verifyCallbackSignature({ rawBody: input.rawBody, signatureHeader: input.signatureHeader, timestampHeader: input.timestampHeader, nonceHeader: input.nonceHeader, secret });
  let payload: any; try { payload = JSON.parse(input.rawBody); } catch (e) { throw new AnimeError({ code: AnimeErrorCode.OUTPUT_INVALID, message: 'Invalid JSON' }); }
  const projectId = typeof payload.project_id === 'string' ? payload.project_id.trim() : null;
  if (!projectId) throw new AnimeError({ code: AnimeErrorCode.WORKFLOW_CONTRACT_MISMATCH, message: 'Missing project_id' });
  const callbackId = payload.callback_id || payload.execution_id || payload.command_id || input.requestId;
  const dedupe = await insertCallback({ project_id: projectId, source: input.source, callback_id: callbackId, raw_payload: payload, verified: true });
  if (dedupe.duplicate) return { accepted: true, duplicate: true, callback_id: callbackId, project_id: projectId };
  const commandId = typeof payload.command_id === 'string' ? payload.command_id : null;
  await animeSupabase.from('outbox_events').insert({ id: randomUUID(), type: 'reconcile_command', payload: { project_id: projectId, command_id: commandId, callback_id: callbackId, source: input.source, request_id: input.requestId, callback_payload: payload }, status: 'pending', attempts: 0 });
  await writeAudit({ project_id: projectId, workflow_name: payload.wf_key || `CALLBACK_${input.source.toUpperCase()}`, action: 'CALLBACK_RECEIVED', entity_type: 'CALLBACK_INBOX', entity_id: callbackId, new_value: { source: input.source, callback_id: callbackId, command_id: commandId }, request_id: input.requestId });
  return { accepted: true, duplicate: false, callback_id: callbackId, project_id: projectId };
}

import { animeSupabase } from '../db/anime.supabase';
import { AnimeError, AnimeErrorCode } from '../errors/anime.errors';
import { clampLimit, type CursorPage, type CursorPaginationInput } from './reads.types';
function extractEpisodeNo(payload: any): number | null { if (payload === null || payload === undefined) return null; const ep = payload.episode_no ?? payload.episode_number; return typeof ep === 'number' && Number.isFinite(ep) ? ep : null; }
export async function listJobs(projectId: string, pagination: CursorPaginationInput): Promise<CursorPage<any>> {
  const limit = clampLimit(pagination.limit);
  let query = animeSupabase.from('api_commands').select('id, project_id, intent, payload, status, created_at').eq('project_id', projectId).order('created_at', { ascending: false }).limit(limit + 1);
  if (pagination.cursor) query = query.lt('created_at', pagination.cursor);
  const { data: rows, error: cmdError } = await query;
  if (cmdError) throw new AnimeError({ code: AnimeErrorCode.INTERNAL, message: 'List failed', cause: cmdError });
  const cmds = rows ?? []; const hasMore = cmds.length > limit; const sliced = hasMore ? cmds.slice(0, limit) : cmds;
  const [states, pending] = await Promise.all([ animeSupabase.from('episode_states').select('*').eq('project_id', projectId), animeSupabase.from('pending_actions').select('*').eq('project_id', projectId) ]);
  const statesByEp = new Map(); for (const st of (states.data ?? [])) if (typeof st.episode_no === 'number') statesByEp.set(st.episode_no, st);
  const allPending = pending.data ?? [];
  const items = sliced.map((cmd: any) => { const epNo = extractEpisodeNo(cmd.payload); return { id: cmd.id, project_id: cmd.project_id, intent: cmd.intent, status: cmd.status, episode_no: epNo, created_at: cmd.created_at, episode_state: epNo !== null ? statesByEp.get(epNo) ?? null : null, pending_actions: allPending.filter((pa: any) => pa.command_id === cmd.id || pa.job_id === cmd.id || (epNo !== null && pa.episode_no === epNo)) }; });

}
export async function getJob(projectId: string, jobId: string): Promise<any> {

import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { writeAudit } from '../audit/audit.writer';
import { animeSupabase } from '../db/anime.supabase';
import { AnimeError, AnimeErrorCode } from '../errors/anime.errors';
import { clampLimit, type CursorPage, type CursorPaginationInput } from '../reads/reads.types';
import { type ApprovalRecord, ApprovalStatus, RESTRICTED_APPROVAL_TYPES } from './approvals.types';
export async function listApprovals(projectId: string, options: CursorPaginationInput & { status?: ApprovalStatus }): Promise<CursorPage<ApprovalRecord>> {
  const limit = clampLimit(options.limit);
  let query = animeSupabase.from('approval_decisions').select('*').eq('project_id', projectId).order('created_at', { ascending: false }).limit(limit + 1);
  if (options.status) query = query.eq('status', options.status);
  if (options.cursor) query = query.lt('created_at', options.cursor);
  const { data, error } = await query;
  if (error) throw new AnimeError({ code: AnimeErrorCode.INTERNAL, message: 'List failed', cause: error });
  const rows = (data ?? []) as ApprovalRecord[]; const hasMore = rows.length > limit; const items = hasMore ? rows.slice(0, limit) : rows;
  return { items, next_cursor: hasMore && items.length > 0 ? items[items.length - 1].created_at : null };
}
export async function decideApproval(input: { project_id: string, approval_id: string, decision: ApprovalStatus.APPROVED | ApprovalStatus.REJECTED, expected_resource_version: number, reason: string, actor_user_id: string, request_id: string }): Promise<ApprovalRecord> {
  const { data: existing, error: fetchError } = await animeSupabase.from('approval_decisions').select('*').eq('project_id', input.project_id).eq('id', input.approval_id).maybeSingle<ApprovalRecord>();
  if (fetchError !== null) throw new AnimeError({ code: AnimeErrorCode.INTERNAL, message: 'Fetch failed', cause: fetchError });
  if (existing === null) throw new AnimeError({ code: AnimeErrorCode.PROJECT_FORBIDDEN, message: 'Not found.' });
  if (existing.status !== ApprovalStatus.PENDING) throw new AnimeError({ code: AnimeErrorCode.VERSION_CONFLICT, httpStatus: 409, message: 'Already decided.' });
  if (existing.resource_version !== input.expected_resource_version) throw new AnimeError({ code: AnimeErrorCode.VERSION_CONFLICT, httpStatus: 409, message: 'Version mismatch.' });
  if (RESTRICTED_APPROVAL_TYPES.has(existing.type) && existing.requested_by === input.actor_user_id) throw new AnimeError({ code: AnimeErrorCode.PROJECT_FORBIDDEN, httpStatus: 403, message: 'Self-approval not allowed.' });
  const auditEventId = randomUUID(); const decidedAtIso = new Date().toISOString();
  const { data: updated, error: updateError } = await animeSupabase.from('approval_decisions').update({ status: input.decision, decision: input.decision, decision_reason: input.reason, decision_by: input.actor_user_id, decided_at: decidedAtIso, audit_event_id: auditEventId, updated_at: decidedAtIso }).eq('project_id', input.project_id).eq('id', input.approval_id).eq('resource_version', input.expected_resource_version).eq('status', ApprovalStatus.PENDING).select('*').maybeSingle<ApprovalRecord>();
  if (updateError !== null || updated === null) throw new AnimeError({ code: AnimeErrorCode.VERSION_CONFLICT, httpStatus: 409, message: 'Concurrent conflict.' });
  await writeAudit({ project_id: input.project_id, user_id: input.actor_user_id, workflow_name: 'APPROVAL_ENGINE', action: `APPROVAL_${input.decision}`, entity_type: existing.type, entity_id: existing.resource_id, new_value: { approval_id: updated.id, status: updated.status, decision: updated.decision }, reason: input.reason, request_id: input.request_id });
  return updated;
}

cat > src/modules/anime/outbox/outbox.dispatcher.ts << 'EOF'
import { dispatchToWf00 } from '../adapters/n8n.adapter';
import { writeAudit } from '../audit/audit.writer';
import { CommandStatus } from '../commands/commands.types';
import { animeSupabase } from '../db/anime.supabase';
import { claimBatch, markDeadLetter, markDispatched, markFailed } from './outbox.repo';
const MAX_RETRIES = 5; const BASE_BACKOFF_MS = 2000;
export function computeExponentialBackoffIso(attempts: number): string { return new Date(Date.now() + BASE_BACKOFF_MS * Math.pow(2, Math.max(0, attempts - 1))).toISOString(); }
async function processDispatchEvent(event: any): Promise<void> {
  const payload = event.payload; const projectId = payload.project_id; const commandId = payload.command_id;
  if (!projectId || !commandId) { await markDeadLetter(event.id, event.attempts, 'Missing IDs'); return; }
  try {
    const dispatchResult = await dispatchToWf00(payload);
    await animeSupabase.from('api_commands').update({ status: CommandStatus.DISPATCHED }).eq('project_id', projectId).eq('id', commandId);
    await markDispatched(event.id);
    await writeAudit({ project_id: projectId, workflow_name: payload.wf_key || 'WF-00', action: 'OUTBOX_DISPATCH_SUCCEEDED', entity_type: 'API_COMMAND', entity_id: commandId, new_value: { outbox_id: event.id, execution_id: dispatchResult.execution_id }, execution_id: dispatchResult.execution_id, request_id: payload.request_id });
  } catch (err: any) {
    const errMsg = err.message || 'Dispatch failed';
    if (event.attempts >= MAX_RETRIES) { await markDeadLetter(event.id, event.attempts, errMsg); await animeSupabase.from('api_commands').update({ status: CommandStatus.MANUAL_REVIEW }).eq('project_id', projectId).eq('id', commandId); await writeAudit({ project_id: projectId, workflow_name: 'OUTBOX_DISPATCHER', action: 'OUTBOX_DEAD_LETTER', entity_type: 'API_COMMAND', entity_id: commandId, reason: errMsg, new_value: { outbox_id: event.id } }); return; }
    await markFailed(event.id, event.attempts, computeExponentialBackoffIso(event.attempts), errMsg);
  }
}
export class OutboxDispatcher {
  private timer: any = null; private running = false;
  public start(pollIntervalMs = 2000): void { if (this.timer) return; this.timer = setInterval(() => void this.tick(), pollIntervalMs); void this.tick(); }
  public stop(): void { if (this.timer) { clearInterval(this.timer); this.timer = null; } }
  public async tick(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.running) return; this.running = true;
    try { const batch = await claimBatch('dispatch_n8n', 10); for (const item of batch) await processDispatchEvent(item); } catch (e) { console.error(e); } finally { this.running = false; }
  }
}
export const outboxDispatcher = new OutboxDispatcher();

import { animeSupabase } from '../db/anime.supabase';
export async function readCommandState(projectId: string, commandId: string): Promise<any> {
  const { data: cmd } = await animeSupabase.from('api_commands').select('*').eq('project_id', projectId).eq('id', commandId).maybeSingle();
  if (!cmd) return { command: null, episode_state: null, pending_actions: [] };
  const ep = cmd.payload?.episode_no || cmd.payload?.episode_number;
  const [st, pa] = await Promise.all([ ep ? animeSupabase.from('episode_states').select('*').eq('project_id', projectId).eq('episode_no', ep).maybeSingle() : Promise.resolve({ data: null }), animeSupabase.from('pending_actions').select('*').eq('project_id', projectId) ]);
  return { command: cmd, episode_state: st.data, pending_actions: (pa.data ?? []).filter((p: any) => p.command_id === commandId || p.job_id === commandId || (ep && p.episode_no === ep)) };
}
export async function findDriftedCommands(staleMinutes = 10, limit = 25): Promise<any[]> {
  const cutoff = new Date(Date.now() - staleMinutes * 60000).toISOString();
  const { data } = await animeSupabase.from('api_commands').select('id, project_id').in('status', ['DISPATCHED', 'ACKNOWLEDGED', 'RECONCILING']).lt('created_at', cutoff).limit(limit);
  return data ?? [];
}

cat > src/modules/anime/supervisor/supervisor.service.ts << 'EOF'
import { writeAudit } from '../audit/audit.writer';
import { CommandStatus } from '../commands/commands.types';
import { animeSupabase } from '../db/anime.supabase';
import { readCommandState } from './supervisor.repo';
export async function reconcileCommand(input: { project_id: string, command_id: string, callback_payload?: any, request_id?: string }): Promise<any> {
  const snap = await readCommandState(input.project_id, input.command_id);
  if (snap.command === null) return { command_id: input.command_id, next_status: CommandStatus.FAILED };
  const prev = snap.command.status; const cb = input.callback_payload?.status?.toUpperCase(); const ep = snap.episode_state?.current_state?.toUpperCase();
  let next = CommandStatus.RECONCILING;
  if (['SUCCEEDED', 'COMPLETED'].includes(cb) || ['COMPLETED', 'PUBLISHED'].includes(ep)) next = CommandStatus.SUCCEEDED;
  else if (['FAILED', 'ERROR'].includes(cb) || ep?.endsWith('_FAILED')) next = CommandStatus.FAILED;
  else if (cb === 'MANUAL_REVIEW' || snap.pending_actions.length > 0) next = CommandStatus.MANUAL_REVIEW;
  if (next !== prev) {
    await animeSupabase.from('api_commands').update({ status: next }).eq('project_id', input.project_id).eq('id', input.command_id);
    await writeAudit({ project_id: input.project_id, user_id: snap.command.user_id, workflow_name: 'SUPERVISOR_RECONCILER', action: 'COMMAND_STATE_RECONCILED', entity_type: 'API_COMMAND', entity_id: input.command_id, previous_value: { status: prev }, new_value: { status: next }, request_id: input.request_id });
  }
  return { command_id: input.command_id, next_status: next };
}

cat > src/modules/anime/supervisor/supervisor.worker.ts << 'EOF'
import { claimBatch, markDeadLetter, markDispatched, markFailed } from '../outbox/outbox.repo';
import { computeExponentialBackoffIso } from '../outbox/outbox.dispatcher';
import { findDriftedCommands } from './supervisor.repo';
import { reconcileCommand } from './supervisor.service';
const MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5;
export class SupervisorWorker {
  private t1: any = null; private t2: any = null; private busy = false;
  public start(poll = 2500, drift = 60000): void { if (!this.t1) { this.t1 = setInterval(() => void this.processReconcileOutbox(), poll); void this.processReconcileOutbox(); } if (!this.t2) { this.t2 = setInterval(() => void this.runDriftScan(), drift); } }
  public stop(): void { if (this.t1) clearInterval(this.t1); if (this.t2) clearInterval(this.t2); }
  public async processReconcileOutbox(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.busy) return; this.busy = true;
    try { const evs = await claimBatch('reconcile_command', 15); for (const ev of evs) { try { await reconcileCommand({ project_id: ev.payload.project_id, command_id: ev.payload.command_id, callback_payload: ev.payload.callback_payload }); await markDispatched(ev.id); } catch (e: any) { if (ev.attempts >= MAX_ATTEMPTS) await markDeadLetter(ev.id, ev.attempts, e.message); else await markFailed(ev.id, ev.attempts, computeExponentialBackoffIso(ev.attempts), e.message); } } } catch (e) { console.error(e); } finally { this.busy = false; }
  }
  public async runDriftScan(): Promise<void> { try { const d = await findDriftedCommands(10, 25); for (const i of d) await reconcileCommand({ project_id: i.project_id, command_id: i.id }); } catch (e) { console.error(e); } }
}
export const supervisorWorker = new SupervisorWorker();

export async function updateStatus(projectId: string, reservationId: string, status: ReservationStatus, actualCost?: number): Promise<any> { const { data, error } = await animeSupabase.from('resource_reservations').update({ status, actual_cost: actualCost, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() }).eq('project_id', projectId).eq('id', reservationId).select().maybeSingle(); if (error || data === null) throw error || new Error('Not found'); return data; }
export async function sumActiveReservations(projectId: string): Promise<any> { const { data } = await animeSupabase.from('resource_reservations').select('status, estimated_cost, actual_cost, expires_at').eq('project_id', projectId).in('status', [ReservationStatus.PROPOSED, ReservationStatus.RESERVED, ReservationStatus.CONSUMED]); let r = 0, c = 0; const now = Date.now(); for (const row of (data ?? [])) { if (row.status === ReservationStatus.CONSUMED) c += Number(row.actual_cost || row.estimated_cost || 0); else if (!row.expires_at || new Date(row.expires_at).getTime() > now) r += Number(row.estimated_cost || 0); } return { reserved_cost: r, consumed_cost: c, total_committed_cost: r + c }; }

cat > src/modules/anime/ledger/ledger.service.ts << 'EOF'
import { writeAudit } from '../audit/audit.writer';
import { animeSupabase } from '../db/anime.supabase';
import { AnimeError, AnimeErrorCode } from '../errors/anime.errors';
import { insertReservation, sumActiveReservations, updateStatus } from './ledger.repo';
import { ReservationStatus } from './ledger.types';
export async function checkBudgetCeiling(projectId: string, addCost = 0): Promise<any> {
  const [p, t] = await Promise.all([ animeSupabase.from('projects').select('id, budget_ceiling').eq('id', projectId).maybeSingle(), sumActiveReservations(projectId) ]);
  if (p.data === null) throw new AnimeError({ code: AnimeErrorCode.PROJECT_FORBIDDEN, message: 'Not found' });
  const ceiling = p.data.budget_ceiling ? Number(p.data.budget_ceiling) : null; const proj = t.total_committed_cost + addCost;
  if (ceiling !== null && proj > ceiling) throw new AnimeError({ code: AnimeErrorCode.PAID_BUDGET_REQUIRED, message: `Exceeds budget (${ceiling})` });
  return { project_id: projectId, budget_ceiling: ceiling, ...t, remaining_headroom: ceiling ? Math.max(0, ceiling - t.total_committed_cost) : null };
}
export async function reserve(input: any): Promise<any> { await checkBudgetCeiling(input.project_id, input.estimated_cost); const r = await insertReservation({ ...input, status: ReservationStatus.RESERVED, expires_at: new Date(Date.now() + (input.ttl_seconds || 900) * 1000).toISOString() }); await writeAudit({ project_id: input.project_id, workflow_name: 'LEDGER', action: 'RESOURCE_RESERVED', entity_type: 'RESERVATION', entity_id: r.id, new_value: r }); return r; }
export async function consume(input: any): Promise<any> { const r = await updateStatus(input.project_id, input.reservation_id, ReservationStatus.CONSUMED, input.actual_cost); await writeAudit({ project_id: input.project_id, workflow_name: 'LEDGER', action: 'RESOURCE_CONSUMED', entity_type: 'RESERVATION', entity_id: r.id }); return r; }
export async function release(input: any): Promise<any> { const r = await updateStatus(input.project_id, input.reservation_id, ReservationStatus.RELEASED, 0); await writeAudit({ project_id: input.project_id, workflow_name: 'LEDGER', action: 'RESOURCE_RELEASED', entity_type: 'RESERVATION', entity_id: r.id }); return r; }

import { COMMAND_INTENT_WF_MAP, type CommandIntent } from '../commands/commands.types';
import { animeSupabase } from '../db/anime.supabase';
import { AnimeError, AnimeErrorCode } from '../errors/anime.errors';
export async function preflightCheck(projectId: string, intent: CommandIntent): Promise<boolean> {
  const { data: p } = await animeSupabase.from('projects').select('id, budget_ceiling').eq('id', projectId).maybeSingle();
  if (p && p.budget_ceiling !== null) { const { data: r } = await animeSupabase.from('resource_reservations').select('estimated_cost, actual_cost, status').eq('project_id', projectId).in('status', ['PROPOSED', 'RESERVED', 'CONSUMED']); let c = 0; for (const row of (r ?? [])) c += Number(row.status === 'CONSUMED' ? row.actual_cost || row.estimated_cost : row.estimated_cost); if (c >= Number(p.budget_ceiling)) throw new AnimeError({ code: AnimeErrorCode.PAID_BUDGET_REQUIRED, message: 'Budget exhausted.' }); }
  const { data: a } = await animeSupabase.from('api_commands').select('id').eq('project_id', projectId).in('status', ['QUEUED', 'DISPATCHED', 'ACKNOWLEDGED', 'RECONCILING']).limit(1);
  if (a && a.length > 0) throw new AnimeError({ code: AnimeErrorCode.STAGE_DEPENDENCY_BLOCKED, message: 'Active job exists.' });
  const { data: cap } = await animeSupabase.from('capability_registry').select('service_name, status').in('service_name', [COMMAND_INTENT_WF_MAP[intent] || 'WF-00', 'n8n']);
  if ((cap ?? []).some((x: any) => x.status.toUpperCase() === 'DEGRADED')) throw new AnimeError({ code: AnimeErrorCode.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE, message: 'Service degraded.' });
  return true;
}

import { FastifyInstance } from 'fastify';
import { env } from '../../config/env';

export async function callDynamicModel(
  fastify: FastifyInstance,
  messages: Array<{ role: 'system' | 'user' | 'assistant'; content: string }>,
  temperature = 0.3
): Promise<{ ok: boolean; reply: string; provider: string; model: string; tokensUsed: number }> {
  // Fetch active providers from DB, ordered by priority
  const { data: providers } = await fastify.supabase
    .from('provider_configs')
    .select('provider_name, model_default, priority')
    .eq('is_enabled', true)
    .order('priority', { ascending: true });

  const activeProviders = providers || [
    { provider_name: 'groq', model_default: env.GROQ_MODEL, priority: 1 },
    { provider_name: 'gemini', model_default: env.GEMINI_MODEL, priority: 2 }
  ];

  for (const p of activeProviders) {
    try {
      if (p.provider_name === 'groq' && env.GROQ_API_KEY) {
        const resp = await fetch('https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/chat/completions', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${env.GROQ_API_KEY}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ model: p.model_default, messages, temperature, max_tokens: 4096 })
        });
        if (resp.ok) {
          const data = await resp.json() as any;
          const text = data.choices?.[0]?.message?.content?.trim();
          if (text) return { ok: true, reply: text, provider: 'groq', model: p.model_default, tokensUsed: data.usage?.total_tokens || 500 };
        }
      }

      if (p.provider_name === 'gemini' && env.GEMINI_API_KEY) {
        const sysMsg = messages.find(m => m.role === 'system')?.content || '';
        const contents = messages.filter(m => m.role !== 'system').map(m => ({
          role: m.role === 'assistant' ? 'model' : 'user',
          parts: [{ text: m.content }]
        }));
        const url = `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/${p.model_default}:generateContent`;
        const resp = await fetch(url, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'x-goog-api-key': env.GEMINI_API_KEY, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ contents, systemInstruction: sysMsg ? { parts: [{ text: sysMsg }] } : undefined, generationConfig: { temperature, maxOutputTokens: 4096 } })
        });
        if (resp.ok) {
          const data = await resp.json() as any;
          const text = data.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts?.[0]?.text?.trim();
          if (text) return { ok: true, reply: text, provider: 'gemini', model: p.model_default, tokensUsed: 600 };
        }
      }
    } catch (_e) {
      fastify.log.warn({ provider: p.provider_name, err: _e }, 'Provider call failed, falling back...');
    }
  }
  return { ok: false, reply: '', provider: 'none', model: 'none', tokensUsed: 0 };
}

export async function getEmbedding(text: string): Promise<number[] | null> {
  if (!env.GEMINI_API_KEY) return null;
  try {
    const url = `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/text-embedding-004:embedContent?key=${env.GEMINI_API_KEY}`;
    const resp = await fetch(url, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'models/text-embedding-004', content: { parts: [{ text }] } })
    });
    if (resp.ok) {
      const data = await resp.json() as any;
      return data.embedding?.values || null;
    }
  } catch (_e) {}
  return null;
}

import { FastifyInstance } from 'fastify';
import { AuthContext } from '../../plugins/auth';
import { getEmbedding } from './modelRouter';

export async function buildSmartContext(
  fastify: FastifyInstance,
  auth: AuthContext,
  userMessage: string,
  projectId: string,
  skillKey: string
): Promise<string> {
  let contextParts: string[] = [];

  // 1. Fetch AI App Knowledge (Screens & Buttons based on keywords)
  const { data: appKnowledge } = await fastify.supabase
    .from('ai_app_knowledge')
    .select('category, name, description')
    .or(`skill_key.eq.${skillKey},skill_key.is.null`)
    .limit(10);
    
  if (appKnowledge && appKnowledge.length > 0) {
    contextParts.push(`APP KNOWLEDGE (Use this to guide the user):\n${JSON.stringify(appKnowledge)}`);
  }

  // 2. Fetch relevant WFs dynamically
  const { data: wfs } = await fastify.supabase
    .from('ai_wf_registry')
    .select('namespace, wf_id, name, description')
    .limit(15);
    
  if (wfs && wfs.length > 0) {
    contextParts.push(`AVAILABLE WORKFLOWS (Select only what is needed):\n${JSON.stringify(wfs)}`);
  }

  // 3. Fetch Skills capabilities
  const { data: skills } = await fastify.supabase
    .from('ai_skill_registry')
    .select('skill_key, name, description, wfs_used')
    .limit(10);

  if (skills && skills.length > 0) {
    contextParts.push(`MODULAR SKILLS:\n${JSON.stringify(skills)}`);
  }

  // 4. RAG Memory (Semantic Search)
  const embedding = await getEmbedding(userMessage);
  if (embedding) {
    const { data: mems } = await fastify.supabase.rpc('match_memory_items', {
      p_owner_id: auth.userId,
      p_project_id: projectId,
      p_query_embedding: `[${embedding.join(',')}]`,
      p_match_threshold: 0.5,
      p_match_count: 5
    });
    if (mems && mems.length > 0) {
      contextParts.push(`RELEVANT MEMORY (RAG):\n${mems.map((m: any) => m.content).join('\n')}`);
    }
  }

  return contextParts.join('\n\n');
}

import { FastifyInstance } from 'fastify';
import { env } from '../../config/env';
import { checkAndRecordQuota, runExecutionGuard } from '../../security/executionGuard';
import { redactSecrets } from '../../security/permissionEngine';
import { callDynamicModel } from '../../core/ai-brain/modelRouter';
import { buildSmartContext } from '../../core/ai-brain/contextBuilder';
import crypto from 'crypto';

export default async function aiRoutes(fastify: FastifyInstance) {
  fastify.post('/chat', { preHandler: [fastify.authenticate] }, async (request, reply) => {
    const startTs = Date.now();
    const auth = request.authContext;
    const body = (request.body as any) || {};
    const userMessage = String(body.message || '').trim();
    const projectId = body.project_id || auth.activeProjectId || '11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111';
    const skillKey = body.skill_key || 'ai_admin';

    if (!userMessage) return reply.code(400).send({ status: 'failed', errors: [{ category: 'INVALID_INPUT', message: 'message is required' }] });

    const quota = await checkAndRecordQuota(fastify, auth.userId, Math.ceil(userMessage.length / 3) + 300);
    if (!quota.allowed) return reply.code(429).send({ status: 'failed', errors: [{ category: 'PROVIDER_RATE_LIMIT', message: quota.reason }] });

    // Build Dynamic Context (RAG + Tools + Skills + App Knowledge)
    const dynamicContext = await buildSmartContext(fastify, auth, userMessage, projectId, skillKey);

    const systemPrompt = [
      'You are BNAI Primary AI Brain (v3.1), a professional Hinglish AI.',
      'You have access to various tools and skills. Use the provided context to answer.',
      'Never claim success without evidence.',
      `Active Skill: ${skillKey}`,
      dynamicContext
    ].filter(Boolean).join('\n\n');

    const aiRes = await callDynamicModel(fastify, [
      { role: 'system', content: systemPrompt },
      { role: 'user', content: String(redactSecrets(userMessage)).slice(0, 8000) }
    ]);

    if (!aiRes.ok) return reply.code(502).send({ status: 'failed', errors: [{ category: 'MODEL_ERROR', message: 'All AI providers failed' }] });

    // Log execution
    try {
      await fastify.supabase.from('execution_records').insert({
        execution_type: 'fast_chat_rag',
        provider: aiRes.provider,
        model: aiRes.model,
        input: { request_id: body.request_id, skill_key: skillKey },
        output: { reply_length: aiRes.reply.length },
        success: true,
        duration_ms: Date.now() - startTs,
        tokens_used: aiRes.tokensUsed
      });
    } catch (_e) {}

    return reply.send({
      request_id: body.request_id || crypto.randomUUID(),
      status: 'completed',
      reply: aiRes.reply,
      message: aiRes.reply,
      provider: aiRes.provider,
      model: aiRes.model,
      verification: { status: 'verified', evidence: [`Dynamic path via ${aiRes.provider}`] }
    });
  });

  // Internal Chat for n8n
  fastify.post('/internal/chat', { preHandler: [fastify.authenticateService] }, async (request, reply) => {
    const body = (request.body as any) || {};
    const prompt = (body.prompt || '').trim();
    if (!prompt) return reply.code(400).send({ error: 'prompt is required' });

    const aiRes = await callDynamicModel(fastify, [
      { role: 'system', content: body.systemPrompt || 'You are a helpful AI assistant.' },
      { role: 'user', content: String(redactSecrets(prompt)).slice(0, 16000) }
    ]);

    if (!aiRes.ok) return reply.code(502).send({ error: 'AI providers unavailable' });
    return reply.send({ reply: aiRes.reply, provider: aiRes.provider, model: aiRes.model });
  });

  // Gateway Execution
  fastify.post('/execute', { preHandler: [fastify.authenticate] }, async (request, reply) => {
    const auth = request.authContext;
    const body = (request.body as any) || {};
    const requestId = (body.request_id || crypto.randomUUID()).trim();
    const intent = (body.intent || '').trim().toUpperCase();
    const projectId = body.project_id || auth.activeProjectId || '11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111';
    const conversationId = body.conversation_id || null;
    const sourceMode = body.source_mode || 'manual';
    const payload = (body.payload || {}) as Record<string, unknown>;

    const guard = await runExecutionGuard(fastify, auth, intent, projectId, payload);
    if (!guard.ok) return reply.code(guard.httpStatus).send({
      request_id: requestId, task_id: null, status: 'failed', result: null,
      errors: [{ category: guard.category || 'FORBIDDEN', message: guard.message || 'Blocked' }],
      warnings: [], verification: { status: 'not_verified', evidence: ['Rejected by Guard'] }
    });

    const wf00Body = {
      request_id: requestId, user_id: auth.userId, workspace_id: auth.workspaceId,
      project_id: projectId, conversation_id: conversationId, intent, source_mode: sourceMode,
      payload: redactSecrets(payload)
    };

    try {
      const wf00Url = `${env.N8N_BASE_URL}/webhook/wf00-gateway`;
      const n8nResp = await fetch(wf00Url, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Accept: 'application/json', 'x-service-token': env.N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET },
        body: JSON.stringify(wf00Body)
      });
      const rawText = await n8nResp.text();
      let parsed: any = null; try { parsed = JSON.parse(rawText); } catch (_e) {}
      
      if (parsed && parsed.request_id) return reply.code(n8nResp.status).send(parsed);
      
      return reply.code(n8nResp.ok ? 200 : 502).send({
        request_id: requestId, task_id: null, status: n8nResp.ok ? 'completed' : 'failed',
        result: parsed || { raw: rawText.slice(0, 1000) },
        errors: n8nResp.ok ? [] : [{ category: 'INTEGRATION_UNAVAILABLE', message: `WF-00 HTTP ${n8nResp.status}` }],
        warnings: [], verification: { status: n8nResp.ok ? 'verified' : 'not_verified', evidence: [`Dispatched to WF-00`] }
      });
    } catch (err: any) {
      return reply.code(503).send({ request_id: requestId, status: 'failed', result: null, errors: [{ category: 'INTEGRATION_UNAVAILABLE', message: err.message }], warnings: [], verification: { status: 'not_verified', evidence: [] } });
    }
  });
}

import { FastifyInstance } from 'fastify';
import { env } from '../../config/env';

export default async function authRoutes(fastify: FastifyInstance) {
  fastify.post('/login', async (request, reply) => {
    const body = (request.body as { email?: string; password?: string }) || {};
    const email = (body.email || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const password = (body.password || '').trim();

    if (!email || !password) return reply.code(400).send({ status: 'failed', errors: [{ category: 'INVALID_INPUT', message: 'email and password required' }] });

    let userId = crypto.randomUUID();
    let workspaceId = env.DEFAULT_WORKSPACE_ID;

    try {
      let { data: userRow } = await fastify.supabase.from('users').select('id').eq('email', email).maybeSingle();
      
      if (!userRow) {
        // New User Provisioning
        const { data: newUser } = await fastify.supabase.from('users').insert({ id: userId, email, status: 'active' }).select().single();
        userRow = newUser;
        
        // Create Default Workspace
        const newWsId = crypto.randomUUID();
        await fastify.supabase.from('workspaces').insert({ id: newWsId, name: `${email}'s Workspace`, type: 'personal' });
        await fastify.supabase.from('workspace_memberships').insert({ workspace_id: newWsId, user_id: userId, role: 'owner' });
        workspaceId = newWsId;

        // Create Default Project
        const newProjId = crypto.randomUUID();
        await fastify.supabase.from('projects').insert({ id: newProjId, workspace_id: workspaceId, name: 'BNAI Default Project', status: 'Active', is_active: true });
      } else {
        userId = userRow.id;
        const { data: memberRow } = await fastify.supabase.from('workspace_memberships').select('workspace_id').eq('user_id', userId).limit(1).maybeSingle();
        if (memberRow) workspaceId = memberRow.workspace_id;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      fastify.log.warn(e, 'Provisioning failed, using defaults');
    }

    const isOwner = env.OWNER_EMAILS.includes(email);
    const role = isOwner ? 'owner_admin' : 'normal_user';

    const token = fastify.jwt.sign({ sub: userId, workspace_id: workspaceId, email, role }, { expiresIn: '7d' });
    return reply.send({ token, access_token: token, user_id: userId, workspace_id: workspaceId, email, role });
  });

  fastify.get('/me', { preHandler: [fastify.authenticate] }, async (request) => {
    return { status: 'completed', user: request.authContext };
  });
}

import { FastifyInstance } from 'fastify';
import { redactSecrets } from '../../security/permissionEngine';
import crypto from 'crypto';

export const DATA_RETENTION_REGISTRY = [
  { category: 'conversation_data', retention_days: 365, deletion_supported: true },
  { category: 'user_memory', retention_days: 730, deletion_supported: true },
  { category: 'project_memory', retention_days: 730, deletion_supported: true },
  { category: 'screenshots', retention_days: 7, deletion_supported: true },
  { category: 'audit_events', retention_days: 1095, deletion_supported: false }
];

export default async function memoryRoutes(fastify: FastifyInstance) {
  fastify.get('/retention-policies', { preHandler: [fastify.authenticate] }, async () => {
    return { status: 'completed', policies: DATA_RETENTION_REGISTRY };
  });

  fastify.post('/read', { preHandler: [fastify.authenticate] }, async (request) => {
    const auth = request.authContext;
    const body = (request.body as any) || {};
    let query = fastify.supabase.from('memory_items').select('*').eq('owner_id', auth.userId).neq('knowledge_status', 'superseded').limit(25);
    if (body.project_id) query = query.eq('project_id', body.project_id);
    const { data, error } = await query;
    return { status: error ? 'failed' : 'completed', memory_items: data || [] };
  });

  fastify.post('/write', { preHandler: [fastify.authenticate] }, async (request) => {
    const auth = request.authContext;
    const body = (request.body as any) || {};
    if (!body.content) return { status: 'failed', errors: [{ message: 'content required' }] };
    const { data } = await fastify.supabase.from('memory_items').insert({
      owner_id: auth.userId, workspace_id: auth.workspaceId, project_id: body.project_id || null,
      scope: body.scope || 'project', content: String(redactSecrets(body.content)).slice(0, 10000),
      category: body.category || 'general', knowledge_status: 'observed', idempotency_key: `MEM-${crypto.randomUUID()}`
    }).select().maybeSingle();
    return { status: 'completed', memory_item: data };
  });

  fastify.post('/delete', { preHandler: [fastify.authenticate] }, async (request) => {
    const auth = request.authContext;
    const body = (request.body as any) || {};
    await fastify.supabase.from('memory_items').delete().eq('id', body.memory_id).eq('owner_id', auth.userId);
    await fastify.supabase.from('data_jobs').insert({ user_id: auth.userId, job_type: 'memory_deletion', status: 'completed', started_at: new Date().toISOString() });
    return { status: 'completed', deleted_id: body.memory_id };
  });
}

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');

const patchesDir = __dirname;

function loadPatch(relPath) {
  return fs.readFileSync(path.join(patchesDir, relPath), 'utf8');
}

function patchWorkflowFile(filePath) {
  if (!fs.existsSync(filePath)) return;
  let content = fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf8');

  // 1. Global Colab Removal -> Dynamic Kaggle Worker URL (Fix E)
  content = content.replace(
    /\{\{\s*\$env\.COLAB_WORKER_URL\s*\}\}\/v1\/image\/sdxl-pulid/g,
    "{{ ($json.user_infrastructure?.kaggle?.worker_url || $('Normalize Input & Enforce SAVE Mode').first().json.user_infrastructure?.kaggle?.worker_url || $env.KAGGLE_WORKER_URL) }}/v1/gpu/sdxl-pulid"
  );
  content = content.replace(
    /\{\{\s*\$env\.COLAB_WORKER_URL\s*\}\}\/v1\/tts\/(svara|supertonic)/g,
    "{{ ($json.user_infrastructure?.ffmpeg?.worker_url || $('Normalize Input & Enforce SAVE Mode').first().json.user_infrastructure?.ffmpeg?.worker_url || $env.FFMPEG_WORKER_URL) }}/v1/tts/$1"
  );
  content = content.replace(
    /\$env\.COLAB_WORKER_URL/g,
    "($json.user_infrastructure?.kaggle?.worker_url || $env.KAGGLE_WORKER_URL)"
  );

  // 2. Fix single-level optional chaining bugs on user_infrastructure
  content = content.replace(/user_infrastructure\?\.kaggle\.worker_url/g, 'user_infrastructure?.kaggle?.worker_url');
  content = content.replace(/user_infrastructure\?\.ffmpeg\.worker_url/g, 'user_infrastructure?.ffmpeg?.worker_url');
  content = content.replace(/user_infrastructure\?\.groq\.api_key/g, 'user_infrastructure?.groq?.api_key');
  content = content.replace(/user_infrastructure\?\.gemini\.api_key/g, 'user_infrastructure?.gemini?.api_key');
  content = content.replace(/user_infrastructure\?\.openai\.api_key/g, 'user_infrastructure?.openai?.api_key');
  content = content.replace(/user_infrastructure\?\.telegram\.bot_token/g, 'user_infrastructure?.telegram?.bot_token');
  content = content.replace(/user_infrastructure\?\.telegram\.channel_id/g, 'user_infrastructure?.telegram?.channel_id');
  content = content.replace(/user_infrastructure\?\.youtube\./g, 'user_infrastructure?.youtube?.');
  content = content.replace(/user_infrastructure\?\.instagram\./g, 'user_infrastructure?.instagram?.');

  const wf = JSON.parse(content);
  if (!Array.isArray(wf.nodes)) return;

  for (const node of wf.nodes) {
    // Fix B: Ensure Execute Workflow Trigger accepts all data
    if (node.type === 'n8n-nodes-base.executeWorkflowTrigger') {
      node.parameters = { inputSource: 'passthrough' };
    }

    // Node-specific JS code replacements
    if (node.name === 'Ingest Gate & Aankh Inspector') {
      node.parameters.jsCode = loadPatch('wf00/ingest_gate.js');
    } else if (node.name === 'Layer 1: Prefix Fast-Track') {
      node.parameters.jsCode = loadPatch('wf00/layer1_fast_track.js');
    } else if (node.name === 'Input Normalizer & Cost Estimator') {
      node.parameters.jsCode = loadPatch('wf12/input_normalizer.js');
    } else if (node.name === 'Final Quota Response Formatter') {
      node.parameters.jsCode = loadPatch('wf12/final_formatter.js');
    } else if (node.name === 'Final Canon Response Formatter') {
      node.parameters.jsCode = loadPatch('wf09/final_formatter.js');
    } else if (node.name === 'Response & Pre-Flight Formatter') {
      node.parameters.jsCode = loadPatch('wf06/final_formatter.js');
    } else if (node.name === 'Normalize Input & Lock SAVE Mode') {
      node.parameters.jsCode = loadPatch('wf02/normalize_input.js');
    } else if (node.name === 'Normalize Input & Enforce SAVE Mode') {
      node.parameters.jsCode = loadPatch('wf03/normalize_input.js');
    }
  }

  fs.writeFileSync(filePath, JSON.stringify(wf, null, 2), 'utf8');
  console.log(`✅ Patched workflow: ${filePath}`);
}

const targetDir = process.argv[2] || process.cwd();
for (const file of fs.readdirSync(targetDir)) {
  if (file.endsWith('.json')) {
    patchWorkflowFile(path.join(targetDir, file));
  }
}

const item = $input.item;
const rawJson = item.json || {};
const body = rawJson.body || rawJson;
const binaryData = item.binary || null;

const explicitIntent = body.intent || rawJson.intent
  ? (body.intent || rawJson.intent).toString().toUpperCase().trim()
  : null;

const user_infrastructure = body.user_infrastructure || rawJson.user_infrastructure || {};
const project_style = body.project_style || rawJson.project_style || { visual_style: 'ANIME' };

const rawText = (
  body.chatInput ||
  body.rawText ||
  body.text ||
  body.message ||
  body.userPrompt ||
  body.user_prompt ||
  (explicitIntent ? `#${explicitIntent.toLowerCase()}` : '')
).toString().trim();

const sessionId = (
  body.sessionId ||
  body.session_id ||
  rawJson.sessionId ||
  `sess_${$execution.id}`
).toString();

const incomingProjectId = (
  body.project_id ||
  body.projectId ||
  rawJson.project_id ||
  (rawJson.headers && rawJson.headers['x-project-id']) ||
  null
);

const episode_no = Number(body.episode_no || body.episode_number || 1);
const season_no = Number(body.season_no || body.season_number || 1);
const incomingMode = body.mode ? body.mode.toString().toUpperCase().trim() : (explicitIntent === 'QUICK_GENERATE_REEL' ? 'QUICK' : 'SAVE');

let modality = 'text_only';
let mediaUrl = body.mediaUrl || body.media_url || null;
let userPrompt = rawText || `Execute ${explicitIntent || 'GENERATE_EPISODE'}`;

const SENSITIVE_KEY_PATTERN = /(api[-_ ]?key|token|secret|password|authorization|bearer|credential|service[-_ ]?role)/i;
function sanitizeObject(obj) {
  if (!obj || typeof obj !== 'object') return obj;
  const cleaned = Array.isArray(obj) ? [] : {};
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(obj)) {
    if (SENSITIVE_KEY_PATTERN.test(k)) cleaned[k] = '[REDACTED_BY_RULE_16]';
    else if (typeof v === 'object' && v !== null) cleaned[k] = sanitizeObject(v);
    else cleaned[k] = v;
  }
  return cleaned;
}

return {
  json: {
    intent: explicitIntent,
    user_infrastructure,
    project_style,
    rawText,
    modality,
    mediaUrl,
    userPrompt,
    user_prompt: userPrompt,
    project_id: incomingProjectId,
    episode_no,
    episode_number: episode_no,
    season_no,
    season_number: season_no,
    sessionId,
    mode: incomingMode,
    trigger_source: rawJson.chatInput !== undefined ? 'CHAT' : 'WEBHOOK',
    sanitized_payload: sanitizeObject(body)
  },
  binary: binaryData || {}
};

  'CREATE_PROJECT', 'OPEN_PROJECT', 'SAVE_BIBLE', 'BIBLE_CHAT'
]);

  const lockedIntent = ctx.intent.toUpperCase().trim();
  return {
    json: {
      ...ctx,
      intent: lockedIntent,
      skip_llm: true,
      classification: {
        intent: lockedIntent,
        confidence: 1.0,
        reason: 'Explicit backend body.intent provided',
        classifier_layer: 'LAYER_0_PAYLOAD_DIRECT',
        extracted_params: {
          episode_number: ctx.episode_no || 1,
          season_no: ctx.season_no || 1,
          mode: ctx.mode || (lockedIntent === 'QUICK_GENERATE_REEL' ? 'QUICK' : 'SAVE')
        }
      }
    },
    binary: $input.item.binary || {}
  };
}

let matchedIntent = null;
const cmdBody = rawText.replace(/^[#!/]+/, '').trim();
if (/^(?:quick_reel|reel|quick_generate_reel)\b/i.test(cmdBody)) matchedIntent = 'QUICK_GENERATE_REEL';
else if (/^(?:ep|episode|generate_episode)\b/i.test(cmdBody)) matchedIntent = 'GENERATE_EPISODE';

if (matchedIntent) {
  return {
    json: {
      ...ctx,
      intent: matchedIntent,
      skip_llm: true,
      classification: {
        intent: matchedIntent,
        confidence: 1.0,
        reason: 'Matched Layer 1 command prefix',
        classifier_layer: 'LAYER_1_PREFIX',
        extracted_params: { episode_number: ctx.episode_no || 1, mode: ctx.mode || 'SAVE' }
      }
    },
    binary: $input.item.binary || {}
  };
}

return { json: { ...ctx, skip_llm: false, classification: null }, binary: $input.item.binary || {} };

import nodemailer from 'nodemailer';

export const transporter = nodemailer.createTransport({
  host: process.env.SMTP_HOST || 'smtp.gmail.com',
  port: parseInt(process.env.SMTP_PORT || '587', 10),
  secure: false,
  auth: {
    user: process.env.SMTP_USER || '',
    pass: process.env.SMTP_PASS || '',
  },
});

export async function sendOTPEmail(to: string, otp: string) {
  if (!process.env.SMTP_USER || !process.env.SMTP_PASS) {
    console.log('\n========================================');
    console.log(`⚠️ SMTP NOT CONFIGURED. TEST OTP for ${to}: ${otp}`);
    console.log('========================================\n');
    return; 
  }
  try {
    await transporter.sendMail({
      from: `"BNAI Assistant" <${process.env.SMTP_USER}>`,
      to,
      subject: 'Your BNAI Assistant Verification Code',
      text: `Your OTP is: ${otp}. It expires in 10 minutes.`,
    });
    console.log(`OTP email sent to ${to}`);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to send OTP email', error);
  }
}

import { FastifyInstance } from 'fastify';
import { AuthContext } from '../../plugins/auth';
import { getEmbedding } from './modelRouter';

export async function buildSmartContext(
  fastify: FastifyInstance,
  auth: AuthContext,
  userMessage: string,
  projectId: string,
  skillKey: string
): Promise<string> {
  let contextParts: string[] = [];
  const isOwner = auth.role === 'owner_admin';

  const { data: appKnowledge } = await fastify.supabase
    .from('ai_app_knowledge')
    .select('category, name, description')
    .limit(10);
  if (appKnowledge && appKnowledge.length > 0) {
    contextParts.push('APP KNOWLEDGE: ' + JSON.stringify(appKnowledge));
  }
  let skillsQuery = fastify.supabase.from('ai_skill_registry').select('skill_key, name, description');
  if (!isOwner) {
    skillsQuery = skillsQuery.eq('owner_only', false);
  }
  const { data: skills } = await skillsQuery.limit(10);
  if (skills && skills.length > 0) {
    contextParts.push('AVAILABLE SKILLS: ' + JSON.stringify(skills));
  }
  if (isOwner) {
    const { data: wfs } = await fastify.supabase
      .from('ai_wf_registry')
      .select('namespace, wf_id, name, description')
      .limit(20);
    if (wfs && wfs.length > 0) {
      contextParts.push('INTERNAL WORKFLOWS (Owner Only): ' + JSON.stringify(wfs));
    }
  } else {
    contextParts.push('STRICT RULE: You are talking to a Normal User. NEVER reveal internal Workflow IDs.');
  }
  const embedding = await getEmbedding(userMessage);
  if (embedding) {
    const { data: mems } = await fastify.supabase.rpc('match_memory_items', {
      p_owner_id: auth.userId,
      p_project_id: projectId,
      p_query_embedding: '[' + embedding.join(',') + ']',
      p_match_threshold: 0.5,
      p_match_count: 5
    });
    if (mems && mems.length > 0) {
      contextParts.push('RELEVANT MEMORY: ' + mems.map((m: any) => m.content).join(' '));
    }
  }
  return contextParts.join('\n\n');
}

import { FastifyInstance } from 'fastify';
import { env } from '../../config/env';

export async function callDynamicModel(
  fastify: FastifyInstance,
  messages: Array<{ role: 'system' | 'user' | 'assistant'; content: string }>,
  temperature = 0.3
): Promise<{ ok: boolean; reply: string; provider: string; model: string; tokensUsed: number }> {
  // Fetch active providers from DB, ordered by priority
  const { data: providers } = await fastify.supabase
    .from('provider_configs')
    .select('provider_name, model_default, priority')
    .eq('is_enabled', true)
    .order('priority', { ascending: true });

  const activeProviders = providers || [
    { provider_name: 'groq', model_default: env.GROQ_MODEL, priority: 1 },
    { provider_name: 'gemini', model_default: env.GEMINI_MODEL, priority: 2 }
  ];

  for (const p of activeProviders) {
    try {
      if (p.provider_name === 'groq' && env.GROQ_API_KEY) {
        const resp = await fetch('https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/chat/completions', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${env.GROQ_API_KEY}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ model: p.model_default, messages, temperature, max_tokens: 4096 })
        });
        if (resp.ok) {
          const data = await resp.json() as any;
          const text = data.choices?.[0]?.message?.content?.trim();
          if (text) return { ok: true, reply: text, provider: 'groq', model: p.model_default, tokensUsed: data.usage?.total_tokens || 500 };
        }
      }

      if (p.provider_name === 'gemini' && env.GEMINI_API_KEY) {
        const sysMsg = messages.find(m => m.role === 'system')?.content || '';
        const contents = messages.filter(m => m.role !== 'system').map(m => ({
          role: m.role === 'assistant' ? 'model' : 'user',
          parts: [{ text: m.content }]
        }));
        const url = `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/${p.model_default}:generateContent`;
        const resp = await fetch(url, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'x-goog-api-key': env.GEMINI_API_KEY, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ contents, systemInstruction: sysMsg ? { parts: [{ text: sysMsg }] } : undefined, generationConfig: { temperature, maxOutputTokens: 4096 } })
        });
        if (resp.ok) {
          const data = await resp.json() as any;
          const text = data.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts?.[0]?.text?.trim();
          if (text) return { ok: true, reply: text, provider: 'gemini', model: p.model_default, tokensUsed: 600 };
        }
      }
    } catch (_e) {
      fastify.log.warn({ provider: p.provider_name, err: _e }, 'Provider call failed, falling back...');
    }
  }
  return { ok: false, reply: '', provider: 'none', model: 'none', tokensUsed: 0 };
}

export async function getEmbedding(text: string): Promise<number[] | null> {
  if (!env.GEMINI_API_KEY) return null;
  try {
    const url = `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/text-embedding-004:embedContent?key=${env.GEMINI_API_KEY}`;
    const resp = await fetch(url, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'models/text-embedding-004', content: { parts: [{ text }] } })
    });
    if (resp.ok) {
      const data = await resp.json() as any;
      return data.embedding?.values || null;
    }
  } catch (_e) {}
  return null;
}
