import { animeSupabase } from '../db/anime.supabase';
import { AnimeError, AnimeErrorCode } from '../errors/anime.errors';
import { clampLimit, type CursorPage, type CursorPaginationInput } from './reads.types';
export async function listScenes(projectId: string, episodeNo: number, pagination: CursorPaginationInput): Promise<CursorPage<any>> {
  const limit = clampLimit(pagination.limit);
  let scenesQuery = animeSupabase.from('scenes').select('id, project_id, episode_no, scene_order, description, visual_prompt, status, created_at').eq('project_id', projectId).eq('episode_no', episodeNo).order('scene_order', { ascending: true }).limit(limit + 1);
  if (pagination.cursor) { const c = Number(pagination.cursor); if (Number.isNaN(c) === false) scenesQuery = scenesQuery.gt('scene_order', c); }
  const [scenesRes, clipsRes] = await Promise.all([ scenesQuery, animeSupabase.from('clips').select('id, project_id, episode_no, scene_order, clip_url, status, provider, duration_sec, created_at').eq('project_id', projectId).eq('episode_no', episodeNo).order('scene_order', { ascending: true }) ]);
  if (scenesRes.error !== null || clipsRes.error !== null) throw new AnimeError({ code: AnimeErrorCode.INTERNAL, message: 'Query failed', cause: scenesRes.error || clipsRes.error });
  const raw = scenesRes.data ?? []; const hasMore = raw.length > limit; const sliced = hasMore ? raw.slice(0, limit) : raw;
  const clipsBy = new Map(); for (const c of (clipsRes.data ?? [])) { if (typeof c.scene_order === 'number') { const arr = clipsBy.get(c.scene_order) || []; arr.push(c); clipsBy.set(c.scene_order, arr); } }
  const items = sliced.map((s: any) => ({ ...s, clips: clipsBy.get(s.scene_order) || [] }));
  return { items, next_cursor: hasMore && items.length > 0 ? String(items[items.length - 1].scene_order) : null };
}

import { animeSupabase } from '../db/anime.supabase';
export async function readCommandState(projectId: string, commandId: string): Promise<any> {
  const { data: cmd } = await animeSupabase.from('api_commands').select('*').eq('project_id', projectId).eq('id', commandId).maybeSingle();
  if (!cmd) return { command: null, episode_state: null, pending_actions: [] };
  const ep = cmd.payload?.episode_no || cmd.payload?.episode_number;
  const [st, pa] = await Promise.all([ ep ? animeSupabase.from('episode_states').select('*').eq('project_id', projectId).eq('episode_no', ep).maybeSingle() : Promise.resolve({ data: null }), animeSupabase.from('pending_actions').select('*').eq('project_id', projectId) ]);
  return { command: cmd, episode_state: st.data, pending_actions: (pa.data ?? []).filter((p: any) => p.command_id === commandId || p.job_id === commandId || (ep && p.episode_no === ep)) };
}
export async function findDriftedCommands(staleMinutes = 10, limit = 25): Promise<any[]> {
  const cutoff = new Date(Date.now() - staleMinutes * 60000).toISOString();
  const { data } = await animeSupabase.from('api_commands').select('id, project_id').in('status', ['DISPATCHED', 'ACKNOWLEDGED', 'RECONCILING']).lt('created_at', cutoff).limit(limit);
  return data ?? [];
}

FILE: src/modules/anime/supervisor/supervisor.service.ts
=========================================
import { writeAudit } from '../audit/audit.writer';
import { CommandStatus } from '../commands/commands.types';
import { animeSupabase } from '../db/anime.supabase';
import { readCommandState } from './supervisor.repo';
export async function reconcileCommand(input: { project_id: string, command_id: string, callback_payload?: any, request_id?: string }): Promise<any> {
  const snap = await readCommandState(input.project_id, input.command_id);
  if (snap.command === null) return { command_id: input.command_id, next_status: CommandStatus.FAILED };
  const prev = snap.command.status; const cb = input.callback_payload?.status?.toUpperCase(); const ep = snap.episode_state?.current_state?.toUpperCase();
  let next = CommandStatus.RECONCILING;
  if (['SUCCEEDED', 'COMPLETED'].includes(cb) || ['COMPLETED', 'PUBLISHED'].includes(ep)) next = CommandStatus.SUCCEEDED;
  else if (['FAILED', 'ERROR'].includes(cb) || ep?.endsWith('_FAILED')) next = CommandStatus.FAILED;
  else if (cb === 'MANUAL_REVIEW' || snap.pending_actions.length > 0) next = CommandStatus.MANUAL_REVIEW;
  if (next !== prev) {
    await animeSupabase.from('api_commands').update({ status: next }).eq('project_id', input.project_id).eq('id', input.command_id);
    await writeAudit({ project_id: input.project_id, user_id: snap.command.user_id, workflow_name: 'SUPERVISOR_RECONCILER', action: 'COMMAND_STATE_RECONCILED', entity_type: 'API_COMMAND', entity_id: input.command_id, previous_value: { status: prev }, new_value: { status: next }, request_id: input.request_id });
    if (next === CommandStatus.SUCCEEDED && input.callback_payload) {
      const cb: any = input.callback_payload;
      const epNo = snap.episode_state?.episode_no || snap.command.payload?.episode_no || snap.command.payload?.episode_number;
      const vUrl = cb.final_video_url || cb.master_video_url || cb.output_media?.final_video_url || cb.output_media?.master_video_url || null;
      const aUrl = cb.full_audio_url || cb.output_media?.full_audio_url || null;
      if (epNo && (vUrl || aUrl)) {
        await animeSupabase.from('episodes').update({
          output_media: {
            final_video_url: vUrl,
            full_audio_url: aUrl,
            thumbnail_url: cb.thumbnail_url || cb.output_media?.thumbnail_url || null,
            rendered_at: new Date().toISOString()
          }
        }).eq('project_id', input.project_id).eq('episode_no', Number(epNo));
        await writeAudit({ project_id: input.project_id, user_id: snap.command.user_id, workflow_name: 'SUPERVISOR_MEDIA_SAVE', action: 'EPISODE_MEDIA_SAVED', entity_type: 'EPISODE', entity_id: String(epNo), new_value: { final_video_url: vUrl, full_audio_url: aUrl }, request_id: input.request_id });
      }
    }
  }
  return { command_id: input.command_id, next_status: next };
}

FILE: src/modules/anime/supervisor/supervisor.worker.ts
=========================================
import { claimBatch, markDeadLetter, markDispatched, markFailed } from '../outbox/outbox.repo';
import { computeExponentialBackoffIso } from '../outbox/outbox.dispatcher';
import { findDriftedCommands } from './supervisor.repo';
import { reconcileCommand } from './supervisor.service';
const MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5;
export class SupervisorWorker {
  private t1: any = null; private t2: any = null; private busy = false;
  public start(poll = 2500, drift = 60000): void { if (!this.t1) { this.t1 = setInterval(() => void this.processReconcileOutbox(), poll); void this.processReconcileOutbox(); } if (!this.t2) { this.t2 = setInterval(() => void this.runDriftScan(), drift); } }
  public stop(): void { if (this.t1) clearInterval(this.t1); if (this.t2) clearInterval(this.t2); }
  public async processReconcileOutbox(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.busy) return; this.busy = true;
    try { const evs = await claimBatch('reconcile_command', 15); for (const ev of evs) { try { await reconcileCommand({ project_id: ev.payload.project_id, command_id: ev.payload.command_id, callback_payload: ev.payload.callback_payload }); await markDispatched(ev.id); } catch (e: any) { if (ev.attempts >= MAX_ATTEMPTS) await markDeadLetter(ev.id, ev.attempts, e.message); else await markFailed(ev.id, ev.attempts, computeExponentialBackoffIso(ev.attempts), e.message); } } } catch (e) { console.error(e); } finally { this.busy = false; }
  }
  public async runDriftScan(): Promise<void> { try { const d = await findDriftedCommands(10, 25); for (const i of d) await reconcileCommand({ project_id: i.project_id, command_id: i.id }); } catch (e) { console.error(e); } }
}

import { writeAudit } from '../audit/audit.writer';
import { AnimeError, AnimeErrorCode } from '../errors/anime.errors';
export async function registerFcmToken(userId: string, token: string, opts: any): Promise<any> { if (!token) throw new AnimeError({ code: AnimeErrorCode.OUTPUT_INVALID, message: 'Token required' }); const id = randomUUID(); const fp = createHash('sha256').update(token).digest('hex').slice(0, 16); await writeAudit({ project_id: opts.project_id, user_id: userId, workflow_name: 'DEVICE_REGISTRY', action: 'REGISTER_FCM_TOKEN', entity_type: 'FCM_DEVICE', entity_id: id, new_value: { platform: opts.platform, fp, token }, request_id: opts.request_id }); return { device_id: id, token_fingerprint: fp }; }

import crypto from 'crypto';
import { FastifyInstance } from 'fastify';
import { env } from '../../config/env';

export default async function authRoutes(fastify: FastifyInstance) {
  fastify.post('/login', async (request, reply) => {
    const body = (request.body as { email?: string; password?: string }) || {};
    const email = (body.email || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const password = (body.password || '').trim();

    if (!email || !password) return reply.code(400).send({ status: 'failed', errors: [{ category: 'INVALID_INPUT', message: 'email and password required' }] });

    let userId = crypto.randomUUID();
    let workspaceId = env.DEFAULT_WORKSPACE_ID;

    try {
      let { data: userRow } = await fastify.supabase.from('users').select('id').eq('email', email).maybeSingle();
      
      if (!userRow) {
        // New User Provisioning
        const { data: newUser } = await fastify.supabase.from('users').insert({ id: userId, email, status: 'active' }).select().single();
        userRow = newUser;
        
        // Create Default Workspace
        const newWsId = crypto.randomUUID();
        await fastify.supabase.from('workspaces').insert({ id: newWsId, name: `${email}'s Workspace`, type: 'personal' });
        await fastify.supabase.from('workspace_memberships').insert({ workspace_id: newWsId, user_id: userId, role: 'owner' });
        workspaceId = newWsId;

        // Create Default Project
        const newProjId = crypto.randomUUID();
        await fastify.supabase.from('projects').insert({ id: newProjId, workspace_id: workspaceId, name: 'BNAI Default Project', status: 'Active', is_active: true });
      } else {
        userId = userRow.id;
        const { data: memberRow } = await fastify.supabase.from('workspace_memberships').select('workspace_id').eq('user_id', userId).limit(1).maybeSingle();
        if (memberRow) workspaceId = memberRow.workspace_id;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      fastify.log.warn(e, 'Provisioning failed, using defaults');
    }

    const isOwner = env.OWNER_EMAILS.includes(email);
    const role = isOwner ? 'owner_admin' : 'normal_user';

    const token = fastify.jwt.sign({ sub: userId, workspace_id: workspaceId, email, role }, { expiresIn: '7d' });
    return reply.send({ token, access_token: token, user_id: userId, workspace_id: workspaceId, email, role });
  });

  fastify.get('/me', { preHandler: [fastify.authenticate] }, async (request) => {
    return { status: 'completed', user: request.authContext };
  });
}

import fp from 'fastify-plugin';
import fastifyJwt from '@fastify/jwt';
import crypto from 'crypto';
import { FastifyRequest, FastifyReply } from 'fastify';
import { env } from '../config/env';

export interface AuthContext {
  userId: string;
  workspaceId: string;
  email: string;
  role: 'owner_admin' | 'normal_user' | 'trusted_service';
  isServiceIdentity: boolean;
}

declare module 'fastify' {
  interface FastifyRequest { authContext: AuthContext; }
  interface FastifyInstance {
    authenticate: (request: FastifyRequest, reply: FastifyReply) => Promise<void>;
    authenticateService: (request: FastifyRequest, reply: FastifyReply) => Promise<void>;
    requireOwner: (request: FastifyRequest, reply: FastifyReply) => Promise<void>;
    requireRole: (roles: Array<'owner_admin' | 'normal_user' | 'trusted_service'>) => (request: FastifyRequest, reply: FastifyReply) => Promise<void>;
  }
}

export default fp(async (fastify) => {
  await fastify.register(fastifyJwt, { secret: env.JWT_SECRET });

  fastify.decorate('authenticate', async (request: FastifyRequest, reply: FastifyReply) => {
    const authHeader = request.headers.authorization || '';
    const token = authHeader.startsWith('Bearer ') ? authHeader.slice(7).trim() : '';
    if (!token) return reply.code(401).send({ status: 'failed', errors: [{ category: 'UNAUTHORIZED', message: 'Bearer token required' }] });

    let decoded: { sub?: string; workspace_id?: string; email?: string; role?: string };
    try {
      decoded = fastify.jwt.verify<{ sub?: string; workspace_id?: string; email?: string; role?: string }>(token);
    } catch (_e) {
      return reply.code(401).send({ status: 'failed', errors: [{ category: 'UNAUTHORIZED', message: 'Invalid or expired token' }] });
    }

    const sub = decoded.sub;
    if (!sub) return reply.code(401).send({ status: 'failed', errors: [{ category: 'UNAUTHORIZED', message: 'Token missing subject' }] });

    const tokenHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(token).digest('hex');
    const { data: blacklisted, error: blErr } = await fastify.supabase.from('token_blacklist').select('id').eq('token_hash', tokenHash).maybeSingle();
    if (blErr) fastify.log.warn({ err: blErr }, 'Token blacklist check failed (fail-open)');
    if (blacklisted) return reply.code(401).send({ status: 'failed', errors: [{ category: 'UNAUTHORIZED', message: 'Token has been revoked' }] });

    const isOwner = env.OWNER_EMAILS.includes((decoded.email || '').toLowerCase()) || decoded.role === 'owner_admin';
    request.authContext = {
      userId: sub,
      workspaceId: decoded.workspace_id || env.DEFAULT_WORKSPACE_ID,
      email: decoded.email || 'user@bnai.dpdns.org',
      role: isOwner ? 'owner_admin' : 'normal_user',
      isServiceIdentity: false
    };
  });

  fastify.decorate('authenticateService', async (request: FastifyRequest, reply: FastifyReply) => {
    const svcToken = (request.headers['x-service-token'] as string | undefined)?.trim();
    const validTokens = [env.TRUSTED_SERVICE_TOKEN, env.N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET, process.env.LEGACY_N8N_TOKEN].filter(Boolean) as string[];
    if (!svcToken || !validTokens.includes(svcToken)) return reply.code(401).send({ status: 'failed', errors: [{ category: 'UNAUTHORIZED', message: 'Invalid x-service-token' }] });

    const body = (request.body as Record<string, unknown>) || {};
    request.authContext = {
      userId: typeof body.userId === 'string' && body.userId ? body.userId : env.DEFAULT_USER_ID,
      workspaceId: typeof body.workspaceId === 'string' && body.workspaceId ? body.workspaceId : env.DEFAULT_WORKSPACE_ID,
      email: 'n8n-service@internal.local',
      role: 'trusted_service',
      isServiceIdentity: true
    };
  });

  fastify.decorate('requireOwner', async (request: FastifyRequest, reply: FastifyReply) => {
    if (!request.authContext) return reply.code(401).send({ status: 'failed', errors: [{ category: 'UNAUTHORIZED', message: 'Authentication required' }] });
    if (request.authContext.isServiceIdentity) return reply.code(403).send({ status: 'failed', errors: [{ category: 'FORBIDDEN', message: 'Service identity cannot access owner routes' }] });
    if (request.authContext.role !== 'owner_admin') return reply.code(403).send({ status: 'failed', errors: [{ category: 'FORBIDDEN', message: 'Owner Admin role required' }] });
  });

  fastify.decorate('requireRole', (roles: Array<'owner_admin' | 'normal_user' | 'trusted_service'>) => {
    return async (request: FastifyRequest, reply: FastifyReply) => {
      if (!request.authContext) return reply.code(401).send({ status: 'failed', errors: [{ category: 'UNAUTHORIZED', message: 'Authentication required' }] });
      if (!roles.includes(request.authContext.role)) return reply.code(403).send({ status: 'failed', errors: [{ category: 'FORBIDDEN', message: `Role required: ${roles.join('|')}` }] });
    };
  });
});

import fp from 'fastify-plugin';
import { createClient, SupabaseClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import { env } from '../config/env';

declare module 'fastify' {
  interface FastifyInstance {
    supabase: SupabaseClient;
    writeAuditEvent: (params: {
      user_id?: string | null; workspace_id?: string | null; project_id?: string | null;
      event_type: string; resource_type: string; resource_id: string; action: string; status: string;
      details?: Record<string, unknown>; ip_address?: string; user_agent?: string;
    }) => Promise<void>;
  }
}

export default fp(async (fastify) => {
  const supabase = createClient(env.SUPABASE_URL, env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, {
    auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false }
  });

  fastify.decorate('supabase', supabase);

  fastify.decorate('writeAuditEvent', async (params) => {
    try {
      await supabase.from('audit_events').insert({
        user_id: params.user_id || null,
        workspace_id: params.workspace_id || null,
        project_id: params.project_id || null,
        event_type: params.event_type,
        resource_type: params.resource_type,
        resource_id: params.resource_id,
        action: params.action,
        status: params.status,
        details: params.details || {},
        ip_address: params.ip_address || null,
        user_agent: params.user_agent || null
      });

      // GAP 8 FIX: Real-time Telegram Alerts for Critical Events
      if (env.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN && env.TELEGRAM_OWNER_CHAT_ID) {
        const isCritical = params.event_type === 'access_denied' || params.status === 'failed';
        if (isCritical) {
          const msg = `🚨 *SYSTEM ALERT*\n*Event:* ${params.event_type}\n*Action:* ${params.action}\n*Status:* ${params.status}\n*User:* ${params.user_id || 'Unknown'}\n*Resource:* ${params.resource_type} (${params.resource_id})\n*Reason:* ${JSON.stringify(params.details || {})}`;
          
          fetch(`https://api.telegram.org/bot${env.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN}/sendMessage`, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({ chat_id: env.TELEGRAM_OWNER_CHAT_ID, text: msg, parse_mode: 'Markdown' })
          }).catch(err => fastify.log.warn({ err }, 'Telegram alert failed'));
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      fastify.log.warn({ err }, 'Audit event write failed');
    }
  });
});

export const QUOTA_LIMITS = { RPM: 30, TPM: 60000, RPD: 1000 };

export async function checkAndRecordQuota(fastify: FastifyInstance, userId: string, estimatedTokens = 500): Promise<{ allowed: boolean; reason?: string }> {
  const now = Date.now();
  const minuteAgo = new Date(now - 60_000).toISOString();
  const dayAgo = new Date(now - 86_400_000).toISOString();

  // GAP 4 FIX: Get recent usage from DB (execution_records)
  const { data: rpmData } = await fastify.supabase
    .from('execution_records')
    .select('id', { count: 'exact' })
    .eq('input->>user_id', userId) // We need to store user_id in execution_records
    .gte('created_at', minuteAgo);

  const { data: rpdData } = await fastify.supabase
    .from('execution_records')
    .select('id', { count: 'exact' })
    .eq('input->>user_id', userId)
    .gte('created_at', dayAgo);

  const rpmCount = rpmData?.length || 0;
  const rpdCount = rpdData?.length || 0;

  if (rpmCount + 1 > QUOTA_LIMITS.RPM) return { allowed: false, reason: `RPM quota exceeded (${QUOTA_LIMITS.RPM}/min)` };
  if (rpdCount + 1 > QUOTA_LIMITS.RPD) return { allowed: false, reason: `RPD daily quota exceeded (${QUOTA_LIMITS.RPD}/day)` };

  return { allowed: true };
}

export async function getQuotaStatus(fastify: FastifyInstance, userId: string) {
  const now = Date.now();
  const minuteAgo = new Date(now - 60_000).toISOString();
  const dayAgo = new Date(now - 86_400_000).toISOString();

  const { data: rpmData } = await fastify.supabase.from('execution_records').select('id').eq('input->>user_id', userId).gte('created_at', minuteAgo);
  const { data: rpdData } = await fastify.supabase.from('execution_records').select('id').eq('input->>user_id', userId).gte('created_at', dayAgo);

  return { limits: QUOTA_LIMITS, used: { rpm: rpmData?.length || 0, tpm: 0, rpd: rpdData?.length || 0 } };
}

export async function runExecutionGuard(fastify: FastifyInstance, auth: AuthContext, intent: string, projectId: string | null | undefined, payload: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<any> {
  const normalizedIntent = (intent || '').trim().toUpperCase();
  
  let dynamicRegistry: Record<string, WorkflowRegistryEntry> = WORKFLOW_REGISTRY;
  try {
    const { data } = await fastify.supabase.from('integrations').select('config').eq('integration_type', 'workflow_registry').maybeSingle();
    if (data && data.config && typeof data.config === 'object' && Object.keys(data.config).length > 0) {
      dynamicRegistry = data.config as Record<string, WorkflowRegistryEntry>;
    }
  } catch (e) {}

  const targetEntry = Object.values(dynamicRegistry).find((w) => w.wfId !== 'WF-00' && w.supportedIntents.includes(normalizedIntent)) || (normalizedIntent === 'CHAT' ? dynamicRegistry['WF-00'] : undefined);
  
  if (!targetEntry) return { ok: false, httpStatus: 400, category: 'INVALID_INPUT', message: `Unregistered intent: ${normalizedIntent}` };
  if (!targetEntry.enabled) return { ok: false, httpStatus: 503, category: 'INTEGRATION_UNAVAILABLE', message: `Target workflow ${targetEntry.wfId} is disabled` };
  if (targetEntry.requiresProject && !projectId) return { ok: false, httpStatus: 400, category: 'INVALID_INPUT', message: `project_id is required for intent ${normalizedIntent}` };
  
  const quotaCheck = await checkAndRecordQuota(fastify, auth.userId, 800);
  if (!quotaCheck.allowed) return { ok: false, httpStatus: 429, category: 'PROVIDER_RATE_LIMIT', message: quotaCheck.reason };

  const authDecision = await evaluateAuthorization(fastify, { auth, action: `EXECUTE_${normalizedIntent}`, resourceType: 'workflow', resourceId: targetEntry.wfId, projectId: projectId || null, risk: targetEntry.risk, requireOwner: false, requireApprovalToken: false, approvalToken: (payload.approval_token as string) || null, actionPayload: payload });
  if (!authDecision.allowed) return { ok: false, httpStatus: authDecision.httpStatus, category: authDecision.errorCategory || 'FORBIDDEN', message: authDecision.reason || 'Blocked by Execution Guard' };

  return { ok: true, httpStatus: 200, targetWf: targetEntry };
}

FILE: src/security/permissionEngine.ts

import { FastifyInstance } from 'fastify';
import { AuthContext } from '../plugins/auth';
import crypto from 'crypto';

export type RiskClassification = 'read_only' | 'low_risk_write' | 'external_side_effect' | 'protected_system_change';

export interface AuthorizationInput {
  auth: AuthContext;
  action: string;
  resourceType: string;
  resourceId?: string | null;
  projectId?: string | null;
  risk: RiskClassification;
  requireOwner?: boolean;
  requireApprovalToken?: boolean;
  approvalToken?: string | null;
  actionPayload?: Record<string, unknown> | null; // NEW
}

export interface AuthorizationResult {
  allowed: boolean;
  httpStatus: number;
  errorCategory?: string;
  reason?: string;
  approvalRecordId?: string | null;
}

const SECRET_REGEXES = [/gsk_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}/g,/sk-proj-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}/g,/\bsk-[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}/g,/AIza[\w-]{30,}/g,/gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}/g,/xox[baprs]-[A-Za-z0-9-]{10,}/g,/Bearer\s+[A-Za-z0-9._~+\/-]{12,}=*/gi];

export function redactSecrets(input: unknown): unknown {
  if (typeof input === 'string') {
    let out = input;
    for (const re of SECRET_REGEXES) { re.lastIndex = 0; out = out.replace(re, '[REDACTED_SECRET]'); }
    return out;
  }
  if (Array.isArray(input)) return input.map(redactSecrets);
  if (input && typeof input === 'object') {
    const out: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(input as Record<string, unknown>)) {
      if (/(password|passwd|secret|token|api[_.-]?key|private[_.-]?key|credential)/i.test(k)) out[k] = '[REDACTED]';
      else out[k] = redactSecrets(v);
    }
    return out;
  }
  return input;
}

export async function evaluateAuthorization(fastify: FastifyInstance, input: AuthorizationInput): Promise<AuthorizationResult> {
  const { auth, action, resourceType, resourceId, projectId, risk, requireOwner, requireApprovalToken, approvalToken, actionPayload } = input;

  if (auth.isServiceIdentity && (requireOwner || risk === 'protected_system_change')) {
    return { allowed: false, httpStatus: 403, errorCategory: 'FORBIDDEN', reason: 'Service identity does not inherit Owner permissions' };
  }

  if (requireOwner && auth.role !== 'owner_admin') {
    return { allowed: false, httpStatus: 403, errorCategory: 'FORBIDDEN', reason: 'Owner Admin authorization required' };
  }

  if (projectId) {
    const { data: proj } = await fastify.supabase.from('projects').select('id, workspace_id').eq('id', projectId).eq('workspace_id', auth.workspaceId).maybeSingle();
    if (proj && proj.workspace_id !== auth.workspaceId) return { allowed: false, httpStatus: 403, errorCategory: 'FORBIDDEN', reason: 'Cross-workspace project access denied' };
  }

  if (requireApprovalToken || risk === 'protected_system_change') {
    if (!approvalToken || !approvalToken.trim()) return { allowed: false, httpStatus: 409, errorCategory: 'APPROVAL_REQUIRED', reason: `Protected action '${action}' requires an explicit SHA-256 approval_token` };

    const tokenHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(approvalToken.trim()).digest('hex');
    const { data: appr } = await fastify.supabase.from('approval_records').select('*').eq('token_hash', tokenHash).eq('workspace_id', auth.workspaceId).maybeSingle();
    
    if (!appr || appr.status !== 'approved') return { allowed: false, httpStatus: 409, errorCategory: 'APPROVAL_REQUIRED', reason: 'Approval token invalid or not in approved status' };
    if (appr.expires_at && new Date(appr.expires_at).getTime() <= Date.now()) return { allowed: false, httpStatus: 409, errorCategory: 'APPROVAL_REQUIRED', reason: 'Approval token has expired' };

    // GAP 5 FIX: TOCTOU Protection (Verify Payload matches)
    if (appr.action_payload && actionPayload) {
      const dbPayloadStr = JSON.stringify(appr.action_payload);
      const reqPayloadStr = JSON.stringify(actionPayload);
      if (dbPayloadStr !== reqPayloadStr) {
        return { allowed: false, httpStatus: 409, errorCategory: 'APPROVAL_REQUIRED', reason: 'TOCTOU Mismatch: Payload differs from approved payload' };
      }
    }
    return { allowed: true, httpStatus: 200, approvalRecordId: appr.id };
  }

  return { allowed: true, httpStatus: 200 };
}

import systemRoutes from './modules/system/system.routes.js';
import incidentsRoutes from './modules/incidents/incidents.routes.js';
import { startHealthCheckJob } from './jobs/healthCheck.job.js';
import Fastify from 'fastify';
import cors from '@fastify/cors';
import helmet from '@fastify/helmet';
import rateLimit from '@fastify/rate-limit';
import { env } from './config/env';
import supabasePlugin from './plugins/supabase';
import authPlugin from './plugins/auth';
import authRoutes from './modules/auth/auth.routes';
import aiRoutes from './modules/ai/ai.routes';
import n8nRoutes from './modules/n8n/n8n.routes';
import memoryRoutes from './modules/memory/memory.routes';
import tasksRoutes from './modules/tasks/tasks.routes';
import ownerRoutes from './modules/owner/owner.routes';
import userRoutes from './modules/user/user.routes';
import skillsRoutes from './modules/skills/skills.routes';
import configRoutes from './modules/config/config.routes';

// --- v3.1 NEW IMPORTS ---
import capabilitiesRoutes from './modules/capabilities/capabilities.routes';
import skillsV31Routes from './modules/skills/skills.v31.routes';
import copilotRoutes from './modules/copilot/copilot.routes';
import approvalsRoutes from './modules/approvals/approvals.routes';
import trustedControllerRoutes from './modules/trusted-controller/trustedController.routes';
import notificationsRoutes from './modules/notifications/notifications.routes';
import filesRoutes from './modules/files/files.routes';
import cinematicRoutes from './modules/cinematic/cinematic.routes';

const server = Fastify({ logger: { level: env.NODE_ENV === 'production' ? 'info' : 'debug' }, bodyLimit: 5 * 1024 * 1024 });

async function bootstrap() {
  await server.register(helmet, { contentSecurityPolicy: false });
  const allowedOrigins = (process.env.CORS_ORIGINS || '').split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
  await server.register(cors, {
    origin: (origin, cb) => {
      if (!origin) return cb(null, true);
      if (allowedOrigins.includes(origin)) return cb(null, true);
      return cb(null, false);
    },
    credentials: true, methods: ['GET', 'POST', 'PUT', 'DELETE', 'PATCH', 'OPTIONS'],
    allowedHeaders: ['Content-Type', 'Authorization', 'X-Service-Token', 'X-Client-Version', 'Accept']
  });
  await server.register(rateLimit, { max: 120, timeWindow: '1 minute' });

  await server.register(supabasePlugin);
  await server.register(authPlugin);

  server.get('/health', async () => ({ status: 'ok', version: '3.1.0', timestamp: new Date().toISOString() }));

  // --- EXISTING v3.0 ROUTES ---
  await server.register(authRoutes, { prefix: '/api/v1/auth' });
  await server.register(aiRoutes, { prefix: '/api/v1/ai' });
  await server.register(n8nRoutes, { prefix: '/api/v1/n8n' });
  await server.register(memoryRoutes, { prefix: '/api/v1/memory' });
  await server.register(tasksRoutes, { prefix: '/api/v1/tasks' });
  await server.register(ownerRoutes, { prefix: '/api/v1/owner' });
  await server.register(userRoutes, { prefix: '/api/v1/user' });
  await server.register(skillsRoutes, { prefix: '/api/v1/skills' });
  await server.register(configRoutes, { prefix: '/api/v1/config' });

  // --- v3.1 NEW ROUTES ---
  await server.register(capabilitiesRoutes, { prefix: '/api/v1/capabilities' });
  await server.register(skillsV31Routes, { prefix: '/api/v1/skills' });
  await server.register(copilotRoutes, { prefix: '/api/v1/copilot' });
  await server.register(approvalsRoutes, { prefix: '/api/v1/approvals' });
  await server.register(trustedControllerRoutes, { prefix: '/api/v1/trusted-controller' });
  await server.register(notificationsRoutes, { prefix: '/api/v1/notifications' });
  await server.register(filesRoutes, { prefix: '/api/v1/files' });
  await server.register(cinematicRoutes, { prefix: '/api/v1/cinematic' });

  // --- EXISTING WORKERS & MODULES ---
  const taskWorker = (await import('./modules/tasks/task.worker')).default;
  await server.register(taskWorker);

  await server.register(systemRoutes, { prefix: '/api/system' });
  await server.register(incidentsRoutes, { prefix: '/api/incidents' });
  startHealthCheckJob(server);

  // --- EXISTING ANIME MODULE ---
  await server.register((await import('./modules/anime')).registerAnimeModule);

  await server.listen({ port: env.PORT, host: '0.0.0.0' });
  server.log.info(`BNAI Backend v3.1 listening on port ${env.PORT}`);
}

bootstrap().catch((err) => { server.log.error(err, 'Fatal startup'); process.exit(1); });

--
-- Name: grant_pg_cron_access(); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: extensions; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION extensions.grant_pg_cron_access() RETURNS event_trigger
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
    SET search_path TO ''
    AS $$
BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT
    FROM pg_event_trigger_ddl_commands() AS ev
    JOIN pg_extension AS ext
    ON ev.objid = ext.oid
    WHERE ext.extname = 'pg_cron'
  )
  THEN
    grant usage on schema cron to postgres with grant option;

    alter default privileges in schema cron grant all on tables to postgres with grant option;
    alter default privileges in schema cron grant all on functions to postgres with grant option;
    alter default privileges in schema cron grant all on sequences to postgres with grant option;

    alter default privileges for user supabase_admin in schema cron grant all
        on sequences to postgres with grant option;
    alter default privileges for user supabase_admin in schema cron grant all
        on tables to postgres with grant option;
    alter default privileges for user supabase_admin in schema cron grant all
        on functions to postgres with grant option;

    grant all privileges on all tables in schema cron to postgres with grant option;
    revoke all on table cron.job from postgres;
    grant select on table cron.job to postgres with grant option;
    revoke trigger on cron.job_run_details from postgres;
  END IF;
END;
$$;


--
-- Name: FUNCTION grant_pg_cron_access(); Type: COMMENT; Schema: extensions; Owner: -
--

COMMENT ON FUNCTION extensions.grant_pg_cron_access() IS 'Grants access to pg_cron';


--
-- Name: grant_pg_graphql_access(); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: extensions; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION extensions.grant_pg_graphql_access() RETURNS event_trigger
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
    SET search_path TO ''
    AS $_$
begin
    if not exists (
        select 1
        from pg_catalog.pg_event_trigger_ddl_commands() ev
        join pg_catalog.pg_extension e on ev.objid = e.oid
        where e.extname = 'pg_graphql'
    ) then
        return;
    end if;

    drop function if exists graphql_public.graphql;
    create or replace function graphql_public.graphql(
        "operationName" text default null,
        query text default null,
        variables jsonb default null,
        extensions jsonb default null
    )
        returns jsonb
        language sql
    as $$
        select graphql.resolve(
            query := query,
            variables := coalesce(variables, '{}'),
            "operationName" := "operationName",
            extensions := extensions
        );
    $$;

    -- Attach the wrapper to the extension so DROP EXTENSION cascades to it,
    -- which in turn triggers set_graphql_placeholder to reinstall the "not enabled" stub.
    alter extension pg_graphql add function graphql_public.graphql(text, text, jsonb, jsonb);

    grant usage on schema graphql to postgres, anon, authenticated, service_role;
    grant execute on function graphql.resolve to postgres, anon, authenticated, service_role;
    grant usage on schema graphql to postgres with grant option;
    grant usage on schema graphql_public to postgres with grant option;
end;
$_$;


--
-- Name: FUNCTION grant_pg_graphql_access(); Type: COMMENT; Schema: extensions; Owner: -
--

COMMENT ON FUNCTION extensions.grant_pg_graphql_access() IS 'Grants access to pg_graphql';


--
-- Name: grant_pg_net_access(); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: extensions; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION extensions.grant_pg_net_access() RETURNS event_trigger
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
    SET search_path TO ''
    AS $$
BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM pg_event_trigger_ddl_commands() AS ev
    JOIN pg_extension AS ext
    ON ev.objid = ext.oid
    WHERE ext.extname = 'pg_net'
  )
  THEN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM pg_roles
      WHERE rolname = 'supabase_functions_admin'
    )
    THEN
      CREATE USER supabase_functions_admin NOINHERIT CREATEROLE LOGIN NOREPLICATION;
    END IF;

    GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA net TO supabase_functions_admin, postgres, anon, authenticated, service_role;

    IF EXISTS (
      SELECT FROM pg_extension
      WHERE extname = 'pg_net'
      -- all versions in use on existing projects as of 2025-02-20
      -- version 0.12.0 onwards don't need these applied
      AND extversion IN ('0.2', '0.6', '0.7', '0.7.1', '0.8.0', '0.10.0', '0.11.0')
    ) THEN
      ALTER function net.http_get(url text, params jsonb, headers jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer) SECURITY DEFINER;
      ALTER function net.http_post(url text, body jsonb, params jsonb, headers jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer) SECURITY DEFINER;

      ALTER function net.http_get(url text, params jsonb, headers jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer) SET search_path = net;
      ALTER function net.http_post(url text, body jsonb, params jsonb, headers jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer) SET search_path = net;

      REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION net.http_get(url text, params jsonb, headers jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer) FROM PUBLIC;
      REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION net.http_post(url text, body jsonb, params jsonb, headers jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer) FROM PUBLIC;

      GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION net.http_get(url text, params jsonb, headers jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer) TO supabase_functions_admin, postgres, anon, authenticated, service_role;
      GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION net.http_post(url text, body jsonb, params jsonb, headers jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer) TO supabase_functions_admin, postgres, anon, authenticated, service_role;
    END IF;
  END IF;
END;
$$;


--
-- Name: FUNCTION grant_pg_net_access(); Type: COMMENT; Schema: extensions; Owner: -
--

COMMENT ON FUNCTION extensions.grant_pg_net_access() IS 'Grants access to pg_net';


--
-- Name: pgrst_ddl_watch(); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: extensions; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION extensions.pgrst_ddl_watch() RETURNS event_trigger
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
    SET search_path TO ''
    AS $$
DECLARE
  cmd record;
BEGIN
  FOR cmd IN SELECT * FROM pg_event_trigger_ddl_commands()
  LOOP
    IF cmd.command_tag IN (
      'CREATE SCHEMA', 'ALTER SCHEMA'
    , 'CREATE TABLE', 'CREATE TABLE AS', 'SELECT INTO', 'ALTER TABLE'
    , 'CREATE FOREIGN TABLE', 'ALTER FOREIGN TABLE'
    , 'CREATE VIEW', 'ALTER VIEW'
    , 'CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW', 'ALTER MATERIALIZED VIEW'
    , 'CREATE FUNCTION', 'ALTER FUNCTION'
    , 'CREATE TRIGGER'
    , 'CREATE TYPE', 'ALTER TYPE'
    , 'CREATE RULE'
    , 'COMMENT'
    )
    -- don't notify in case of CREATE TEMP table or other objects created on pg_temp
    AND cmd.schema_name is distinct from 'pg_temp'
    THEN
      NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';
    END IF;
  END LOOP;
END; $$;


--
-- Name: pgrst_drop_watch(); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: extensions; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION extensions.pgrst_drop_watch() RETURNS event_trigger
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
    SET search_path TO ''
    AS $$
DECLARE
  obj record;
BEGIN
  FOR obj IN SELECT * FROM pg_event_trigger_dropped_objects()
  LOOP
    IF obj.object_type IN (
      'schema'
    , 'table'
    , 'foreign table'
    , 'view'
    , 'materialized view'
    , 'function'
    , 'trigger'
    , 'type'
    , 'rule'
    )
    AND obj.is_temporary IS false -- no pg_temp objects
    THEN
      NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';
    END IF;
  END LOOP;
END; $$;


--
-- Name: set_graphql_placeholder(); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: extensions; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION extensions.set_graphql_placeholder() RETURNS event_trigger
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
    SET search_path TO ''
    AS $_$
    DECLARE
    graphql_is_dropped bool;
    BEGIN
    graphql_is_dropped = (
        SELECT ev.schema_name = 'graphql_public'
        FROM pg_event_trigger_dropped_objects() AS ev
        WHERE ev.schema_name = 'graphql_public'
    );

    IF graphql_is_dropped
    THEN
        create or replace function graphql_public.graphql(
            "operationName" text default null,
            query text default null,
            variables jsonb default null,
            extensions jsonb default null
        )
            returns jsonb
            language plpgsql
            set search_path to ''
        as $$
            DECLARE
                server_version float;
            BEGIN
                server_version = (SELECT (SPLIT_PART((select version()), ' ', 2))::float);

                IF server_version >= 14 THEN
                    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
                        'errors', jsonb_build_array(
                            jsonb_build_object(
                                'message', 'pg_graphql extension is not enabled.'
                            )
                        )
                    );
                ELSE
                    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
                        'errors', jsonb_build_array(
                            jsonb_build_object(
                                'message', 'pg_graphql is only available on projects running Postgres 14 onwards.'
                            )
                        )
                    );
                END IF;
            END;
        $$;
    END IF;

    END;
$_$;


--
-- Name: FUNCTION set_graphql_placeholder(); Type: COMMENT; Schema: extensions; Owner: -
--

COMMENT ON FUNCTION extensions.set_graphql_placeholder() IS 'Reintroduces placeholder function for graphql_public.graphql';


--
-- Name: graphql(text, text, jsonb, jsonb); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: graphql_public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION graphql_public.graphql("operationName" text DEFAULT NULL::text, query text DEFAULT NULL::text, variables jsonb DEFAULT NULL::jsonb, extensions jsonb DEFAULT NULL::jsonb) RETURNS jsonb
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
    AS $$
            DECLARE
                server_version float;
            BEGIN
                server_version = (SELECT (SPLIT_PART((select version()), ' ', 2))::float);

                IF server_version >= 14 THEN
                    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
                        'errors', jsonb_build_array(
                            jsonb_build_object(
                                'message', 'pg_graphql extension is not enabled.'
                            )
                        )
                    );
                ELSE
                    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
                        'errors', jsonb_build_array(
                            jsonb_build_object(
                                'message', 'pg_graphql is only available on projects running Postgres 14 onwards.'
                            )
                        )
                    );
                END IF;
            END;
        $$;


--
-- Name: get_auth(text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: pgbouncer; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION pgbouncer.get_auth(p_usename text) RETURNS TABLE(username text, password text)
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO ''
    AS $_$
  BEGIN
      RAISE DEBUG 'PgBouncer auth request: %', p_usename;

      RETURN QUERY
      SELECT
          rolname::text,
          CASE WHEN rolvaliduntil < now()
              THEN null
              ELSE rolpassword::text
          END
      FROM pg_authid
      WHERE rolname=$1 and rolcanlogin;
  END;
  $_$;


--
-- Name: cascade_revoke_session_tokens(); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.cascade_revoke_session_tokens() RETURNS trigger
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
    AS $$
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
    UPDATE approval_tokens
    SET revoked_at = NOW(),
        revoke_reason = 'session_deleted'
    WHERE session_id = OLD.session_id
      AND used_at IS NULL
      AND revoked_at IS NULL;
    RETURN OLD;
  END IF;

  IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE'
     AND NEW.revoked_at IS NOT NULL
     AND OLD.revoked_at IS NULL THEN
    UPDATE approval_tokens
    SET revoked_at = NOW(),
        revoke_reason = COALESCE(NEW.revoke_reason, 'session_expired')
    WHERE session_id = NEW.session_id
      AND used_at IS NULL
      AND revoked_at IS NULL;
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

-- Name: check_skills_limit(); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.check_skills_limit() RETURNS trigger
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
    AS $$
declare
  skill_count int;
  begin
    select count(*) into skill_count
      from skills
        where project_id = new.project_id;

          if skill_count >= 10 then
              raise exception 'Ek project me maximum 10 skills hi allow hain!';
                end if;

                  return new;
                  end;
                  $$;

--
-- Name: outbox_events; Type: TABLE; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE TABLE public.outbox_events (
    id uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL,
    type text NOT NULL,
    payload jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb NOT NULL,
    status text DEFAULT 'pending'::text NOT NULL,
    attempts integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    next_attempt_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    last_error text,
    created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    dispatched_at timestamp with time zone,
    notified boolean DEFAULT false NOT NULL
);


--
-- Name: claim_outbox_batch(text, integer); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.claim_outbox_batch(p_type text, p_batch_size integer DEFAULT 10) RETURNS SETOF public.outbox_events
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    AS $$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  WITH claimed AS (
    SELECT oe.id
    FROM public.outbox_events oe
    WHERE oe.status = 'pending'
      AND oe.next_attempt_at <= now()
      AND (
        oe.type = p_type
        OR (p_type = 'dispatch_n8n' AND oe.type LIKE 'ANIME_COMMAND_DISPATCH:%')
      )
    ORDER BY oe.next_attempt_at ASC, oe.created_at ASC
    LIMIT GREATEST(1, LEAST(p_batch_size, 100))
    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
  )
  UPDATE public.outbox_events target
  SET
    status = 'processing',
    attempts = target.attempts + 1
  FROM claimed
  WHERE target.id = claimed.id
  RETURNING target.*;
END;
$$;

    intent text NOT NULL,
    payload jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb NOT NULL,
    status text DEFAULT 'QUEUED'::text NOT NULL,
    idempotency_key text NOT NULL,
    body_hash text NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL
);


--
-- Name: insert_anime_command_atomic(uuid, uuid, text, text, jsonb, text, text, text, uuid, text, jsonb); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.insert_anime_command_atomic(p_command_id uuid, p_project_id uuid, p_user_id text, p_intent text, p_payload jsonb, p_status text, p_idempotency_key text, p_body_hash text, p_outbox_id uuid, p_outbox_type text, p_outbox_payload jsonb) RETURNS public.api_commands
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    AS $$
DECLARE
  v_cmd public.api_commands;
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO public.api_commands (
    id, project_id, user_id, intent, payload, status, idempotency_key, body_hash
  ) VALUES (
    p_command_id, p_project_id, p_user_id, p_intent, p_payload, p_status, p_idempotency_key, p_body_hash
  )
  RETURNING * INTO v_cmd;

  INSERT INTO public.outbox_events (
    id, type, payload, status, attempts, next_attempt_at
  ) VALUES (
    p_outbox_id, p_outbox_type, p_outbox_payload, 'pending', 0, now()
  );

  RETURN v_cmd;
END;
$$;


--
-- Name: match_documents(public.vector, integer, jsonb); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.match_documents(query_embedding public.vector, match_count integer DEFAULT 5, filter jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb) RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, content text, metadata jsonb, similarity double precision)
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
    AS $$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    d.id,
    d.content,
    d.metadata,
    1 - (d.embedding <=> query_embedding) AS similarity
  FROM documents d
  WHERE d.metadata @> filter
  ORDER BY d.embedding <=> query_embedding
  LIMIT match_count;
END;
$$;
